Huroof-e-Muqatta'at ka bayan pehle ho chuka hai. Yeh aayatein hain wazeh, jali, roshan, saaf aur khule Quran ki. Tamam kamon ki asliyat, ab guzishta aur aayinda ki khabrein is mein hain aur sab sacchi aur khuli. Hum tere samne Musa (A.S) aur Firaun ka saccha waqia bayan karte hain. Jaise aur aayat mein hai hum tere samne behtareen waqia bayan karte hain. Is tarah ke goya tu us ke hone ke waqt wahin maujood tha. Firaun ek mutakabbir, sarkash aur bad-dimagh insaan tha. Us ne logon par buri tarah qabza jama rakha tha aur unhein aapas mein ladwa-ladwa kar un mein phoot aur ikhtilaf dalwa kar unhein kamzor karke khud un par jabr-o-ta'addi ke sath saltanat kar raha tha. Khusoosan Bani Israel ko toh is zalim ne neest-o-nabood karne ka faisla kar liya tha. Aur din raat yeh bechare bekar mein ghisete jate the. Is par bhi us ka gussa thanda na hota tha, yeh un ki narina aulad ko qatl karwa dalta tha. Taake yeh afradi quwwat se mehroom rahein, quwwat wale na ho jayen aur is liye bhi ke yeh zaleel-o-khwar rahein aur is liye bhi ke use dar tha ke un mein se ek bacche ke hathon meri saltanat tabah hone wali hai. Baat yeh hai ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) Misr ki hukumat mein se ma'a apni biwi sahiba Hazrat Sarah ke ja rahe the aur yahan ke sarkash badshah ne Hazrat Sarah ko londi banane ke liye aap se cheen liya jinhein Allah ne us kafir se mehfooz rakha aur use aap par dast-darazi karne ki qudrat hi hasil na hui toh us waqt Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne bator pesh-goi farmaya tha ke teri aulad mein se ek ki aulad ke ladke ke hathon mulk-e-Misr is qaum se jata rahega aur unka badshah us ke samne zillat ke sath halak hoga. Chunke yeh riwayat chali aa rahi thi aur un ke dars mein zikr hota rehta tha jise Qibti bhi sunte the jo Firaun ki qaum thi, unhon ne darbar mein mukhbari ki jab se Firaun ne yeh zalimana aur saffakana qanoon bana diya ke Bani Israel ke bacche qatl kar diye jayen aur un ki bacchiyan chhod di jayen. Lekin Rab ko jo manzoor hota hai woh apne waqt par ho kar hi rehta hai. Hazrat Musa (A.S) zinda reh gaye aur Allah ne aap ke hathon is aari sarkash ko zaleel-o-khwar kiya, Falhamdulillah. Chunancha farman hai ke hum ne in za'ifon aur kamzoron par raham karna chaha. Zahir hai ke Allah ki chahat ka poora hona yaqeeni hai. Jaise farmaya aayat (Wa awrasnal-qaumallazina kanu yustad'afuna mashariqal-ardi wa magharibahal-lati barakna fiha, wa tammat kalimatu rabbikal-husna 'ala Bani Isra'ila bima sabaru, wa dammarna ma kana yasna'u Fir'aunu wa qawmuhu wa ma kanu ya'rishun) (Surah Al-A'raf: 137). Aap ne is giri padi qaum ko un ki tamam cheezon ka malik bana diya. Firaun ne apni tamam-tar taqat ka muzahira kiya lekin use Allah ki taqat ka andaza hi na tha. Aakhir Allah ka irada ghalib raha aur jis ek bacche ki khatir hazaron be-gunah bacchon ka khoon-e-na-haq bahaya tha.

Is bache ko qudrat ne usi ki god mein palwaya, parwan charhaya, aur usi ke hathon iska, iske lashkar ka aur iske mulk-o-maal ka khatma karaya taake woh jaan le aur maan le ke woh Allah ka zaleel maskeen be-dast-o-pa ghulam tha aur Rabb ki chahat par kisi ki chahat ghalib nahin aa sakti. Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur unki qoum ko Allah ne Misr ki saltanat di aur Firaun jis se khaif tha woh samne aa gaya aur tabah-o-barbad hua. Falhamdulillah.

Bachon ka qatl aur Bani Israel. Marwi hai ke jab Bani Israel ke hazarha bachay qatl ho chukay toh Qibtiyon ko andesha hua ke agar Banu Israel khatam hogaye toh jitnay zaleel kaam aur behooda khidmatain hukumat un se le rahi hain kahin hum se na lene lagen. Toh darbar mein meeting hui aur yeh raye qarar payi ke ek saal maar dalay jayen aur dusray saal qatl na kiye jayen. Hazrat Haroon A.S us saal tawallud huay jis saal bachon ko qatl na kiya jata tha lekin Hazrat Musa A.S us saal paida huay jis saal Bani Israel ke larkay aam tor par teh-e-tegh ho rahay thay. Auratein gasht karti rehti thin aur hamla auraton ka khayal rakhti thin. Un ke naam likh liye jatay thay. Waza-e-hamal ke waqt yeh auratein pahunch jati thin agar larki hui toh wapas chali jati thin aur agar larka hua toh foran jalladon ko khabar kar deti thin. Yeh log tez churay liye usi waqt aa jatay thay aur maa baap ke samnay usi waqt un ke bachon ko tukray tukray karkay chalay jatay thay. Hazrat Musa A.S ki walida ka jab hamal hua toh aam hamal ki tarah is ka pata na chala aur jo auratein is kaam par mamoor thin aur jitni daiyan aati thin kisi ko hamal ka pata na chala. Yahan tak ke Hazrat Musa A.S tawallud bhi hogaye. Aap ki walida sakht pareshan honay lagin aur har waqt khaufzada rehnay lagin aur apnay bachay se mohabbat bhi itni thi ke kisi maa ko apnay bachay se itni na hogi. Ek maa par hi kya mauqoof Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa A.S ka chehra hi aisa banaya tha ke jis ki nazar par jati thi us ke dil mein un ki mohabbat baith jati thi. Jaise Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ka irshad hai aayat (وَاَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّيْ ڬ وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلٰي عَيْنِيْ) (Surah Taha: 39) "Main ne apni khusoosi mohabbat se tumhein nawaza." Pas jab ke walida-e-Musa A.S har waqt kabida khatir, khaufzada aur ranjeeda rehnay lagin toh Allah ne un ke dil mein khayal dala ke isay doodh pilati rahay aur khauf ke mauqay par unhein daryaye Neel mein baha day jis ke kinaray par hi aap ka makan tha. Chunancha yahi kiya ke ek peti ki waza ka sandooq bana liya, is mein Hazrat Musa A.S ko rakh diya, doodh pila diya kartin aur is mein sula diya kartin. Jahan koi aisa darauna mauqa aata toh is sandooq ko darya mein baha detin aur ek dori se isay bandh rakha tha, khauf tal janay ke baad isay khench letin. Ek martaba ek aisa shakhs ghar mein aanay laga jis se aap ki walida sahiba ko bohat dehshat hui, daur kar bachay ko sandooq mein lita kar darya mein baha diya aur jaldi aur ghabrahat mein dori bandhni bhool gayin. Sandooq pani ki maujon ke sath zor se behnay laga aur Firaun ke mahal ke paas guzra toh londiyon ne isay utha liya aur Firaun ki biwi ke paas le gayin. Rastay mein unhon ne isay dar ke maaray khola na tha ke kahin tohmat un par na lag jaye. Jab Firaun ki biwi ke paas isay khola gaya toh dekha ke is mein toh ek nihayat khubsurat noorani chehray wala sahih salim bacha leta hua hai jisay dekhte hi un ka dil mehar-e-mohabbat se bhar gaya aur is bacha ki pyari shakal dil mein ghar kar gayi.

Is mein bhi Rabb ki maslahat thi ke Firon ki biwi ko rah-e-rast dikhaye aur Firon ke samne uska dar laye aur use aur uske guroor ko dhaye to farmata hai ke Aal-e-Firon ne is sandoq ko utha liya aur anjam-kaar woh unki dushmani aur unke ranj-o-malal ka baais hua. Muhammad bin Ishaq waghaira farmate hain ke "Likuna" ka laam laam-e-aqibat hai, laam-e-taleel nahi. Is liye ke unka irada na tha, bazahir yeh theek bhi maloom hota hai lekin maani ko dekhte hue laam ko laam-e-taleel samajhne mein bhi koi harj nahi aata, is liye ke Allah Ta'ala ne unhe is sandoqche ka uthane wala is liye banaya tha ke Allah use unke liye dushman bana de aur unke ranj-o-gham ka baais banaye, balke is mein ek lutf yeh bhi hai ke jis se woh bachna chahte the woh unke sir chadh gaya. Is liye is ke baad hi farmaya gaya ke Firon, Haman aur unke sathi khata-kar the. 

Riwayat hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne Qadriya ko (jo log ke taqdeer ke munkar hain) ek khat mein likha ke Musa ke sabiq ilm mein Firon ke dushman aur is ke liye baais-e-ranj-o-gham the, jaise Quran ki is aayat se sabit hai, lekin tum kehte ho ke Firon chahta to Musa uske madadgar aur dost hote. 

Phir farmata hai ke is bachche ko dekhte hue Firon bad-guman hua ke aisa na ho kisi Israeli aurat ne ise phenk diya ho aur kahin yeh wohi na ho jis ke qatal karne ke liye hazaron bachchon ko fana kar chuka ho. Yeh soch kar us ne ise bhi qatal karna chaha lekin uski biwi Hazrat Asiya (R.A) ne inki sifarish ki. Firon ko iske irade se roka aur kaha: Ise qatal na kijiye, bahut mumkin hai ke yeh aap ki aur meri aankhon ki thandak ka baais ho. Magar Firon ne jawab diya ke teri aankhon ki thandak ho lekin mujhe to aankhon ki thandak ki zaroorat nahi. Allah ki shaan dekhiye ke yehi hua ke Hazrat Asiya ko Allah ne apna deen naseeb farmaya aur Hazrat Musa ki wajah se unhone hidayat paayi aur is mutakabbir ko Allah ne apne nabi ke haathon halak kiya. Nisai waghaira ke hawale se Surah Taha ki tafseer mein Hadis-e-Fatoon mein yeh qissa poora bayan ho chuka hai. 

Hazrat Asiya farmati hain: Shayad hamein nafa pohnchaye. Unki ummeed Allah ne poori ki, duniya mein Hazrat Musa inki hidayat ka zariya bane aur aakhirat mein jannat mein jaane ka. Aur kehti hain ke yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke hum ise apna bachcha bana lein. Inki koi aulad na thi to chaha ke Hazrat Musa ko mutabanna bana lein. In mein se kisi ko shoor na tha ke qudrat kis tarah poshida apna irada poora kar rahi hai.

Jise Allah rakhe use kaun chakhe? Musa A.S ki walida ne jab un ko sandooqche mein daal kar dariya mein baha diya toh bahut pareshan huin aur siwaye Allah ke sache Rasool aur apne lakht-e-jigar Hazrat Musa ke aap ko kisi aur cheez ka khayal hi na raha. Sabr-o-sukoon jata raha, dil mein bajuz Hazrat Musa ki yaad ke aur koi khayal hi nahin aata tha. Agar Allah ki taraf se un ki diljam'i na kar di jati toh woh toh besabri mein raaz faash kar detin, logon se keh detin ke is tarah mera bacha zaya ho gaya. Lekin Allah ne un ka dil thehra diya, dhaaras di aur taskeen de di ke tera bacha tujhe zaroor milega. Walida-e-Musa ne apni badi bachi se jo zara samajhdaar thin farmaya ke beti tum is sandooq par nazar jama kar kinare kinare chali jao, dekho kya anjaam hota hai? Mujhe bhi khabar karna. Toh yeh door se use dekhti hui chalein lekin is anjaan pan se ke koi aur na samajh sake ke yeh is ka khayal rakhti hui is ke sath ja rahi hai. Firaun ke mahal tak pahunchte hue aur wahan is ki londiyon ko uthate hue toh aap ki hamshira ne dekha, phir wahin bahar khadi reh gayin ke shayad kuch maloom ho sake ke andar kya ho raha hai. Wahan yeh hua ke jab Hazrat Asiya ne Firaun ko is ke khooni irade se baaz rakha aur bache ko apni parwarish mein le liya toh shahi mahal mein jitni daiyan thin sab ko bacha diya gaya. Har ek ne bashari mohabbat-o-pyaar se unhein doodh pilana chaha lekin ba-hukm-e-Ilahi Hazrat Musa ne kisi ke doodh ka ek ghoont bhi na piya. Aakhir apni londiyon ke hathon use bahar bheja ke kisi daiya ko talash karo jis ka doodh yeh piye, us ko le aao. Chunke Rabb-ul-Alameen ko yeh manzoor na tha ke woh apni walida ke siwa kisi aur ka doodh piye aur is mein sab se badi maslahat yeh thi ke is bahane Hazrat Musa apni maa tak pahunch jayen. Londiyan aap ko le kar jab bahar niklin toh aap ki behen ne aap ko pehchan liya lekin un par zahir na kiya aur na khud unhein koi pata chal saka. Aap ki behen toh pehle bahut pareshan thi lekin is ke baad Allah ne unhein sabr-o-sukoon de diya aur woh khamosh aur mutma'in thin. Behen ne un ko kaha ke tum is qadar pareshan kyun ho? Unhon ne kaha yeh bacha kisi daiya ka doodh nahin peeta aur hum is ke liye daiya ki talash mein hain. Yeh sun kar hamshira-e-Musa ne farmaya agar tum kaho toh tumhein ek dai ka pata doon? Mumkin hai bacha un ka doodh pi le aur is ki parwarish karein aur is ki khair-khwahi karein. Yeh sun kar unhein kuch shak guzra ke yeh ladki is ladke ki asliyat hai aur is ke maa baap se waqif hai, use giraftar kar liya aur poocha tumhein kya maloom ke woh aurat is ki kafalat aur khair-khwahi karegi? Us ne foran jawab diya SubhanAllah. Kaun na chahe ga ke shahi darbar mein is ki izzat ho. Inaam-o-ikram ki khatir kaun is se hamdardi na karega.

Un ki samajh mein bhi aa gaya ke hamara pehla guman ghalat tha yeh toh theek keh rahi hai, isay chhor diya aur kaha achha chal is ka makan dikha. Yeh unhein lekar apne ghar le aayin aur apni walida ki taraf ishara karke kaha inhein dijiye. Sarkari aadmiyon ne unhein diya toh bacha doodh peene laga. Fauran yeh khabar Hazrat Asiya (R.A) ko di gayi, woh yeh sun kar bahut khush huin aur unhein apne mahal mein bulwaya aur bahut kuch inaam-o-ikram kiya, lekin yeh ilm na tha ke fi-alwaq yeh hi is bachay ki walida hain. Faqat is wajah se ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne un ka doodh piya tha woh un se bahut khush huin. Kuch dinon tak toh yunhi kaam chalta raha. Aakhir-kar ek roz Hazrat Asiya (R.A) ne farmaya meri khushi hai ke tum mahal mein aa jao, yahin raho saho aur isay doodh pilati raho. Umm-e-Musa (R.A) ne jawab diya ke yeh toh mujh se nahin ho sakta, main baal bachon wali hoon, mere miyan bhi hain, main inhein doodh pila diya karungi phir aap ke haan bhej diya karungi. Yeh tay hua aur is par Firaun ki biwi bhi razamand ho gayin. Umm-e-Musa (R.A) ka khauf aman se, faqiri amiri se, bhook aasoodgi se, daulat-o-izzat mein badal gayi. Rozana inaam-o-ikram patin. Khana, kapra, shahi tareeq par milta aur apne pyare bachay ko apni god mein paltin. Ek hi raat ya ek hi din ya ek din ek raat ke baad hi Allah ne is ki museebat ko rahat se badal diya. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai jo shakhs apna kaam dhanda kare aur is mein Allah ka khauf aur meri sunnaton ka lihaz kare us ki misaal Umm-e-Musa (R.A) ki misaal hai ke apne hi bachay ko doodh pilaye aur ujrat bhi le. Allah ki zaat pak hai, isi ke haath mein tamam kaam hai, isi ka chaha hua hota hai aur jis kaam ko woh na chahe hargiz nahin hota. Yaqeenan woh har us shakhs ki madad karta hai jo is par tawakkul kare. Is ki farmanbardari karne wale ka dastgeer wohi hai. Woh apne nek bandon ke aarhay waqt kaam aata hai aur un ki takleefon ko door karta hai aur un ki tangi ko farakhi se badalta hai. Aur har ranj ke baad rahat ata farmata hai. Fasubhanahu ma a'zama sha'nah. Phir farmata hai ke hum ne isay is ki maa ki taraf wapas lota diya taake is ki aankhein thandi rahein aur isay apne bachay ka sadma na rahe. Aur woh Allah ke wadon ko bhi sacha samjhe aur yaqeen maan le ke woh zaroor Nabi aur Rasool bhi hone wala hai. Ab aap ki walida itminan se aap ki parwarish mein mashghool ho gayin aur isi tarah parwarish ki jis tarah ek buland darja Nabi ki honi chahiye. Haan Rabb ki hikmatein be-ilmon ki nigah se ojhal rehti hain. Woh Allah ke ahkaam ki ghayat ko aur farmanbardari ke nek anjam ko nahin sochte. Zahiri nafa nuqsan ke paband rehte hain aur duniya par rijhay hue hote hain. Inhein yeh nahin soojhta ke mumkin hai jisay woh bura samajh rahe hain achha ho aur bahut mumkin hai ke jisay woh achha samajh rahe hain woh bura ho, yani ek kaam bura jante hon magar kya khabar ke is mein qudrat ne kya fawaid posheeda rakhein hain.

Jise Allah rakhe use kaun chakhe? Musa A.S ki walida ne jab un ko sandooqche mein daal kar dariya mein baha diya toh bahut pareshan huin aur siwaye Allah ke sache Rasool aur apne lakht-e-jigar Hazrat Musa ke aap ko kisi aur cheez ka khayal hi na raha. Sabr-o-sukoon jata raha, dil mein bajuz Hazrat Musa ki yaad ke aur koi khayal hi nahin aata tha. Agar Allah ki taraf se un ki diljam'i na kar di jati toh woh toh besabri mein raaz faash kar detin, logon se keh detin ke is tarah mera bacha zaya ho gaya. Lekin Allah ne un ka dil thehra diya, dhaaras di aur taskeen de di ke tera bacha tujhe zaroor milega. Walida-e-Musa ne apni badi bachi se jo zara samajhdaar thin farmaya ke beti tum is sandooq par nazar jama kar kinare kinare chali jao, dekho kya anjaam hota hai? Mujhe bhi khabar karna. Toh yeh door se use dekhti hui chalein lekin is anjaan pan se ke koi aur na samajh sake ke yeh is ka khayal rakhti hui is ke sath ja rahi hai. Firaun ke mahal tak pahunchte hue aur wahan is ki londiyon ko uthate hue toh aap ki hamshira ne dekha, phir wahin bahar khadi reh gayin ke shayad kuch maloom ho sake ke andar kya ho raha hai. Wahan yeh hua ke jab Hazrat Asiya ne Firaun ko is ke khooni irade se baaz rakha aur bache ko apni parwarish mein le liya toh shahi mahal mein jitni daiyan thin sab ko bacha diya gaya. Har ek ne bashari mohabbat-o-pyaar se unhein doodh pilana chaha lekin ba-hukm-e-Ilahi Hazrat Musa ne kisi ke doodh ka ek ghoont bhi na piya. Aakhir apni londiyon ke hathon use bahar bheja ke kisi daiya ko talash karo jis ka doodh yeh piye, us ko le aao. Chunke Rabb-ul-Alameen ko yeh manzoor na tha ke woh apni walida ke siwa kisi aur ka doodh piye aur is mein sab se badi maslahat yeh thi ke is bahane Hazrat Musa apni maa tak pahunch jayen. Londiyan aap ko le kar jab bahar niklin toh aap ki behen ne aap ko pehchan liya lekin un par zahir na kiya aur na khud unhein koi pata chal saka. Aap ki behen toh pehle bahut pareshan thi lekin is ke baad Allah ne unhein sabr-o-sukoon de diya aur woh khamosh aur mutma'in thin. Behen ne un ko kaha ke tum is qadar pareshan kyun ho? Unhon ne kaha yeh bacha kisi daiya ka doodh nahin peeta aur hum is ke liye daiya ki talash mein hain. Yeh sun kar hamshira-e-Musa ne farmaya agar tum kaho toh tumhein ek dai ka pata doon? Mumkin hai bacha un ka doodh pi le aur is ki parwarish karein aur is ki khair-khwahi karein. Yeh sun kar unhein kuch shak guzra ke yeh ladki is ladke ki asliyat hai aur is ke maa baap se waqif hai, use giraftar kar liya aur poocha tumhein kya maloom ke woh aurat is ki kafalat aur khair-khwahi karegi? Us ne foran jawab diya SubhanAllah. Kaun na chahe ga ke shahi darbar mein is ki izzat ho. Inaam-o-ikram ki khatir kaun is se hamdardi na karega.

Ghonsay se maut: Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke ladakpan ka zikr kiya, ab un ki jawani ka waqiya bayan ho raha hai ke Allah ne unhein hikmat-o-ilm ata farmaya. Ya'ni nabuwwat di. Nek log aisa hi badla paate hain, phir is waqiye ka zikr ho raha hai jo Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke Misr chhorne ka ba'is bana aur jis ke baad Allah ki rahmat ne un ka rukh kiya, yeh Misr chhor kar Madyan ki taraf chal diye. Aap ek martaba shehar mein aate hain, ya to maghrib ke baad ya zuhr ke waqt, ke log khane peene mein ya sone mein mashghool hain, raston par aamad-o-raft nahin thi, to dekhte hain ke do shakhs lad jhagad rahe hain. Ek Israeli hai, dusra Qibti hai. Kahin raaz khul to nahin gaya. Dekhtay hain ke kal wala Israeli aaj ek aur Qibti se lar raha hai. Aap ko dekhtay hi kal ki tarah aaj bhi faryaad aur duhai denay laga. Aap ne farmaya tum baray fitna aadmi ho. Yeh suntay hi woh ghabra gaya. Jab Hazrat Musa A.S ne us zaalim Qibti ko rokne ke liye us ki taraf haath barhana chaha to yeh shakhs apne kameena pan aur buzdili se samajh baitha ke aap ne mujhe bura kaha hai aur mujhe pakarna chahte hain, apni jaan bachane ke liye shor machana shuru kar diya ke Musa! Kya jaise tu ne kal ek shakhs ka khoon kiya tha aaj meri jaan bhi lena chahta hai? Kal ka waqea sirf usi ki maujoodgi mein hua tha is liye ab tak kisi ko pata na chala tha? Lekin aaj us ki zabaan se us Qibti ko pata chala ke yeh kaam Musa A.S ka hai. Is buzdil darpok ne yeh bhi saath hi kaha ke tu zameen par sarkash ban kar rehna chahta hai aur teri tabiyat mein hi sulah pasandi nahin. Qibti yeh sun kar bhaga dora darbaar-e-Firauni mein pohancha aur wahan mukhbari ki. Firaun ki bad-dili ki ab koi had na rahi aur foran sipahi doraye ke Musa A.S ko laakar pesh karein.

Gumnam hamdard, is aane wale ko 'rajul' kaha gaya. Arabi mein 'rajul' kehte hain qadmon ko. Is ne jab dekha ke sipah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke ta'aqub mein ja rahi hai to yeh apne paon par tezi se daura aur ek qareeb ke raste se nikal kar jhat se aap ko ittila de di ke yahan ke amir-umara aap ke qatl ke irade kar chuke hain, aap shehar chhor dijiye. Main aap ka bahi-khwah hoon, meri maan lijiye.

Musa A.S ka farar: Firaun aur Firauniyon ke irade jab us shakhs ki zabani aap ko maloom ho gaye toh aap wahan se tan-tanha chup-chap nikal kharay huay. Chunke is se pehle ki zindagi ke ayyam aap ke shahzadon ki tarah guzray thay, safar bahut kara maloom hua lekin khauf-o-haras ke sath idhar udhar dekhte seedhay chalay ja rahay thay aur Allah Ta'ala se duayein mangte ja rahay thay ke aye Allah! In zalimon se yani Firaun aur Firauniyon se nijat de. Marwi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki rehbari ke wastay aik farishta bheja tha jo ghoray par aap ke paas aaya aur aap ko rasta dikha gaya, Wallahu A'lam. Thori der mein aap jangalon aur biyabanon se nikal kar Madyan ke rastay par pahunch gaye toh khush huay aur farmanay lagay mujhe Zaat-e-Bari se umeed hai ke woh rah-e-rast par hi le jaye ga. Allah ne aap ki umeed bhi poori ki. Aur aakhirat ki seedhi rah na sirf batayi balkay auron ko bhi seedhi rah batane wala banaya. Madyan ke paas ke kunway par aaye toh dekha ke charwahay pani khench-khench kar apne-apne janwaron ko pila rahay hain. Wahin aap ne yeh bhi mulahiza farmaya ke do auratein apni bakriyon ko in janwaron ke sath pani peene se rok rahi hain toh aap ko in bakriyon par aur in auraton ki is halat par ke bechariyan pani nikal kar pila nahin saktin aur in charwahon mein se koi is ka rawadar nahin ke apne khenchay huay pani mein se in ki bakriyon ko bhi pila de, toh aap ko reham aaya. Un se daryaft farmaya ke tum apne janwaron ko is pani se kyun rok rahi ho? Unhon ne jawab diya ke hum toh pani nikal nahin saktin, jab yeh apne janwaron ko pani pila kar chalay jayen toh bacha-khucha pani hum apni bakriyon ko pila dengi. Hamaray walid sahab hain lekin woh bahut hi boorhay hain. Bakriyon ko pani pilaya: Aap ne khud hi in janwaron ko pani khench kar pila diya. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A farmatay hain ke is kunway ke munh ko in charwahon ne aik baray pathar se band kar diya tha. Jis chattan ko do aadmi mil kar sarka saktay thay, aap ne tan-tanha us pathar ko hata diya aur aik dol nikala tha jis mein Allah ne barkat di aur in dono larkiyon ki bakriyan shikam-seer ho gayin. Ab aap thakay haray bhookay pyasay aik darakht ke saye talay baith gaye. Misr se Madyan tak paidal bhagay doray aaye thay. Pairon mein chhalay par gaye thay, khanay ko kuch paas nahin tha, darakhton ke pattay aur ghaas-phoos khatay rahay thay. Pait peeth se lag raha tha aur ghaas ka sabz rang bahar se nazar aa raha tha. Aadhi khajoor se bhi us waqt aap tarsay huay thay halankeh us waqt ki sari makhlooq se zyada barguzeeda Allah ke nazdeek aap thay, Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaih. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A farmatay hain ke do raat ka safar karke main Madyan gaya aur wahan ke logon se us darakht ka pata poocha jis ke neechay Allah ke Kaleem ne sahara liya tha. Logon ne aik darakht ki taraf ishara kiya, main ne dekha ke woh aik sarsabz darakht hai. Mera janwar bhooka tha, us ne is mein munh dala, pattay munh mein le kar bari der tak ba-diqqat chabata raha lekin aakhir us ne nikal dalay.

Main ne Kaleemullah ke liye dua ki aur wahan se wapas laut aaya. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aap us darakht ko dekhne ke liye gaye thay jis se Allah ne aap se baatein ki thin jaise ke aage aayega. Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Suddi farmate hain yeh babool ka darakht tha. Al-garaz us darakht tale baith kar aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke aye Rabb main tere ehsano ka mohtaj hoon. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A farmatay hain ke is kunway ke munh ko in charwahon ne aik baray pathar se band kar diya tha. Jis chattan ko do aadmi mil kar sarka saktay thay, aap ne tan-tanha us pathar ko hata diya aur aik dol nikala tha jis mein Allah ne barkat di aur in dono larkiyon ki bakriyan shikam-seer ho gayin. Ab aap thakay haray bhookay pyasay aik darakht ke saye talay baith gaye. Misr se Madyan tak paidal bhagay doray aaye thay. Pairon mein chhalay par gaye thay, khanay ko kuch paas nahin tha, darakhton ke pattay aur ghaas-phoos khatay rahay thay. Pait peeth se lag raha tha aur ghaas ka sabz rang bahar se nazar aa raha tha. Aadhi khajoor se bhi us waqt aap tarsay huay thay halankeh us waqt ki sari makhlooq se zyada barguzeeda Allah ke nazdeek aap thay, Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaih. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A farmatay hain ke do raat ka safar karke main Madyan gaya aur wahan ke logon se us darakht ka pata poocha jis ke neechay Allah ke Kaleem ne sahara liya tha. Logon ne aik darakht ki taraf ishara kiya, main ne dekha ke woh aik sarsabz darakht hai. Mera janwar bhooka tha, us ne is mein munh dala, pattay munh mein le kar bari der tak ba-diqqat chabata raha lekin aakhir us ne nikal dalay.

Main ne Kaleemullah ke liye dua ki aur wahan se wapas laut aaya. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aap us darakht ko dekhne ke liye gaye thay jis se Allah ne aap se baatein ki thin jaise ke aage aayega. Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Suddi farmate hain yeh babool ka darakht tha. Al-garaz us darakht tale baith kar aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke aye Rabb main tere ehsano ka mohtaj hoon. Atta ka qaul hai ke us aurat ne bhi aap ki dua suni.

Hazrat Musa aur Shuaib (Alaihimas Salam) ka mu'ahida. In dono bachiyon ki bakriyon ko jab Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne pani pila diya toh yeh apni bakriyan lekar wapas apne ghar gayin. Baap ne dekha ke aaj waqt se pehle yeh aa gayi hain toh daryaft farmaya ke aaj kya baat hai? Unhon ne sacha waqia keh sunaya. Aap ne usi waqt in dono mein se ek ko bheja ke jao aur in ko mere paas le aao. Woh Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke paas aayin aur jis tarah ghar ghar hast pak daman afifa aurton ka dastoor hota hai sharm-o-haya se apni chadar mein lipti hui parde ke sath chal rahi thin. Munh bhi chadar ke kinare se chupaye hue thin phir is danai aur sadaqat ko dekhiye ke sirf yeh nahin kaha ke mere abba aap ko bula rahe hain kyunke is mein shuba ki baton ki gunjaish thi saaf keh diya ke mere walid aap ki mazdoori dene ke liye aur is ehsan ka badla utarne ke liye bula rahe hain. Jo aap ne hamari bakriyon ko pani pilakar hamare sath kiya hai. Kaleemullah ko jo bhooke pyase tan-tanha musafir aur be-kharch thay yeh mauqa ghanimat maloom hua yahan aaye. Inhein ek buzurg samajh kar in ke sawal par apna sara waqia bila-kam-o-kast sunaya. Unhon ne dil joi ki aur farmaya ab kya khauf hai? In zalimon ke hath se aap nikal aaye. Yahan in ki hukumat nahin. Baaz mufassireen kehte hain ke yeh buzurg Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) thay jo Madyan walon ki taraf Allah ke Nabi ban kar aaye hue thay. Yeh mashhoor qaul Imam Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) ka hai aur bohat se ulama bhi yahi farmate hain. Tabrani ki ek hadith mein hai ke jab Hazrat Saad (R.A) apni qaum ki taraf se elchi ban kar Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue toh aap ne farmaya Shuaib ki qaum aur Musa ke susral walon ko marhaba ho ke tumhein hidayat ki gayi. Baaz kehte hain ke yeh Hazrat Shuaib ke bhatije thay koi kehta hai ke qaum-e-Shuaib ke ek momin mard thay. Baaz ka qaul hai ke Shuaib (A.S) ka zamana toh Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke zamane se bohat pehle ka hai. In ka qaul Quran mein apni qaum se yeh marwi hai ke (وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوْطٍ مِّنْكُمْ بِبَعِيْدٍ) (Surah Hud: 89) Loot ki qaum tum se kuch door nahin. Aur yeh bhi Quran se sabit hai ke Lootiyon ki halakat Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah ke zamane mein hui thi. Aur yeh bhi bohat zahir hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim aur Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke darmiyan ka zamana bohat lamba zamana hai. Taqreeban char sau saal ka hai jaise aksar muwarrikheen ka qaul hai han baaz logon ne is mushkil ka yeh jawab diya hai ke Hazrat Shuaib ki bari lambi umar hui thi. In ka maqsad ghaliban is aitraz se bachna hai wallahu a'lam. Ek aur baat bhi khayal mein rahe ke agar yeh buzurg Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) hi hue toh chahiye tha ke Quran mein is mauqa par in ka naam saaf le diya jata. Han albatta baaz ahadees mein yeh aaya hai ke yeh Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) thay. Lekin in ahadees ki sanadein sahih nahin jaise ke hum anqareeb warid karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala, Bani Israel ki kitabon mein in ka naam Thairun batlaya gaya hai wallahu a'lam.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ke sahibzade farmate hain, 'Thairun' Hazrat Shoaib A.S ke bhatije thay. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke yeh 'Yathribi' thay. Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain yeh baat us waqt hoti ke jab is bare mein koi khabar marwi hoti aur aisa hai nahin. Un ki dono sahibzadiyon mein se ek ne baap ki tawajjo dilayi. Yeh tawajjo dilane wali sahibzadi wahi thin jo aap ko bulane gayi thin. Kaha ke inhe aap hamari bakriyon ki charayi par rakh lijiye kyunke woh kaam karne wala achha hota hai jo qawi aur amanat-dar ho. Baap ne beti se poocha tum ne yeh kaise jaan liya ke in mein yeh dono wasf hain? Bachhi ne jawab diya ke das aadmi mil kar jis patthar ko kunwein se hata sakte thay unhone tanha us ko hata diya, un se unki quwwat ka andaza ba-aasani ho sakta hai. Amanat-dari ka ilm mujhe is tarah hua ke jab main inhe le kar aap ke paas aane lagi to is liye ke raaste se na-waqif thay main aage ho li, unhone kaha tum mere peeche raho aur jahan raasta badalna ho us taraf kankar phenk dena main samajh lunga ke mujhe is raaste chalna chahiye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A farmate hain teen shakhs ki si ziraki, mamla-fahami, danayi aur door-bini kisi aur mein nahin payi gayi. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ki danayi ke jab unhone apne baad khilafat ke liye Janab-e-Umar R.A ko muntakhab kiya. Hazrat Yusuf A.S ke khareedne wale Misri jinhone ba-ek-nazar Hazrat Yusuf A.S ko pehchan liya aur ja kar apni biwi se farmaya ke inhe achhi tarah rakho. Aur us buzurg ki sahibzadi jinhone Hazrat Musa A.S ki nisbat apne baap se sifarish ki ke inhe apne kaam par rakh lijiye. Yeh sunte hi us bachhi ke baap ne farmaya ke agar aap pasand karein to main is mehar par in do bachhiyon mein se ek ka nikah aap ke saath kar deta hoon ke aap aath saal tak hamari bakriyan charayein. In dono ka naam Safoora aur Auliya tha ya Safoora aur Sharfa ya Safoora aur Liya. Ashab-e-Abi Hanifa Rahimahullah ne isi se istidlal kiya hai ke jab koi shakhs is tarah ki bai kare ke in do ghulamon mein se ek ko ek sau ke badle farokht karta hoon aur khareedar manzoor kar le to yeh bai sabit aur sahih hai. Wallahu A'lam. Us buzurg ne kaha ke aath saal to zaroori hai is ke baad aap ko ikhtiyar hai das saal ka. Agar aap apni khushi se do saal tak aur bhi mera kaam karein to achha hai warna aap par lazmi nahin. Aap dekhenge ke main bad-aadmi nahin aap ko takleef na doonga. Imam Auza'i ne is se istidlal karke farmaya hai ke agar koi kahe main falan cheez ko naqd das aur udhaar bees par bechta hoon to yeh bai sahih hai aur khareedar ko ikhtiyar hai ke das par naqd le ya bees par udhaar le. Woh is hadith ka bhi yahi matlab le rahe hain jis mein hai jo shakhs do bai ek bai mein kare uske liye kami wali bai hai ya sood. Lekin yeh mazhab gaur-talab hai jis ki tafseel ka yeh maqam nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Ashab-e-Imam Muhammad ne is aayat se istidlal karke kaha hai ke khane peene aur kapde par kisi ko mazdoori aur kaam-kaaj par laga lena durust hai.

Is ki daleel mein Ibn-e-Majah ki aik hadith bhi hai jo is baat mein hai ke mazdoor muqarrar karna is mazdoori par ke woh pait bhar kar khana kha liya karega, is mein hadith laye hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Surah Taa-Seen (Namal) ki tilawat ki, jab Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke zikr tak pohanchay to farmane lagay Musa (A.S) ne apne pait ke bharne aur apni sharm-gah ko bachane ke liye aath saal ya das saal ke liye apne aap ko mulazim kar liya. Is hadith ka rawi Muslama bin Ali Khushni hai jo zaeef hai. Yeh hadith dusri sanad se bhi marwi hai lekin woh sanad bhi nazar se khali nahin. Kaleemullah ne buzurg ki is shart ko qabool kar liya aur farmaya ke hum tum mein yeh tay shuda faisla hai, mujhe ikhtiyar hoga ke khwah das saal pooray karoon ya aath saal ke baad chhor doon, aath saal ke baad aap ka koi haq-e-mazdoori mujh par lazim nahin. Hum Allah Ta'ala ko apne is mamlay par gawah karte hain, usi ki karsazi kaafi hai. To go das saal poora karna mubah hai lekin woh fazil cheez hai, zaroori nahin, zaroori aath saal hain, jaise Mina ke aakhri do din ke baray mein Allah ka hukum hai aur jaise ke hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Hamza bin Amr Aslami (R.A) se farmaya tha jo bakasrat rozay rakha karte thay ke agar tum safar mein rozay rakho to tumhein ikhtiyar hai aur agar na rakho to tumhein ikhtiyar hai, bawajood-e-ke dusri daleel se rakhna afzal hai. Chunancha is ki daleel bhi aa chuki hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne das saal hi pooray kiye. Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Saeed bin Jubair se Yahudiyon ne sawal kiya ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne aath saal pooray kiye thay ya das saal? To aap ne farmaya ke mujhe khabar nahin, phir main Arab ke bohat baray aalim Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke paas gaya aur un se yahi sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya in dono mein jo zyada aur paak muddat thi wahi aap ne poori ki yani das saal. Allah Ta'ala ke Nabi jo kehte hain poora karte hain. Hadith-e-Funoon mein hai ke sail Nasrani tha lekin Bukhari mein jo hai wahi aula hai. Wallahu A'alam. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se sawal kiya ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaun si muddat poori ki thi? To jawab mila ke in dono mein se jo kamil aur mukammal muddat thi. Aik mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) se kisi ne poocha, aap ne Jibraeel (A.S) se poocha, Jibraeel (A.S) ne aur farishtay se, yahan tak ke farishtay ne Allah se. Allah ne jawab diya ke dono mein hi paak aur poori muddat yani das saal.

Ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne das saal ki muddat ka poora karna bataya ke yeh bhi farmaya ke agar tujh se poocha jaye ke kaun si ladki se Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne nikah kiya tha toh jawab dena ke dono mein jo choti thin aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne muddat-e-daraz ko poora karna bataya phir farmaya ke jab Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Hazrat Shuaib (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se rukhsati le kar jaane lage toh apni biwi sahiba se farmaya ke apne walid se kuch bakriyan le lo jin se hamara guzara ho jaye. Aap ne apne walid se sawal kiya jis par unhon ne wada kiya ke is mein se jitni chit kabri bakriyan hongi sab tumhari. Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne bakriyon ke pet par apni lakdi pheri toh har ek ko do-do teen-teen bache hue aur sab ke sab chit kabre jin ki nasl ab tak talash karne se mil sakti hai. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Shuaib (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki sab bakriyan kale rang ki khubsurat thin. Jitne bache un ke is saal hue sab ke sab be-aib the aur bade bade bhare hue thanon wale aur zyada doodh dene wale. In tamam riwayaton ka madar Abdullah bin Lahi'ah par hai jo hafiza ke ache nahin aur dar hai ke yeh riwayatein marfoo na hon. Chunancha aur sanad se yeh Anas bin Malik (R.A) se mauqoofan marwi hai. Aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke sab bakriyon ke bache is saal ablaq hue siwaye ek bakri ke. Jin sab ko aap le gaye (A.S / Alaihis Salam).

To jawab mila ke in dono mein se jo kamil aur mukammal muddat thi. Aik mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) se kisi ne poocha, aap ne Jibraeel (A.S) se poocha, Jibraeel (A.S) ne aur farishtay se, yahan tak ke farishtay ne Allah se. Allah ne jawab diya ke dono mein hi paak aur poori muddat yani das saal.

Ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne das saal ki muddat ka poora karna bataya ke yeh bhi farmaya ke agar tujh se poocha jaye ke kaun si ladki se Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne nikah kiya tha toh jawab dena ke dono mein jo choti thin aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne muddat-e-daraz ko poora karna bataya phir farmaya ke jab Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Hazrat Shuaib (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se rukhsati le kar jaane lage toh apni biwi sahiba se farmaya ke apne walid se kuch bakriyan le lo jin se hamara guzara ho jaye. Aap ne apne walid se sawal kiya jis par unhon ne wada kiya ke is mein se jitni chit kabri bakriyan hongi sab tumhari. Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne bakriyon ke pet par apni lakdi pheri toh har ek ko do-do teen-teen bache hue aur sab ke sab chit kabre jin ki nasl ab tak talash karne se mil sakti hai. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Shuaib (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki sab bakriyan kale rang ki khubsurat thin. Jitne bache un ke is saal hue sab ke sab be-aib the aur bade bade bhare hue thanon wale aur zyada doodh dene wale. In tamam riwayaton ka madar Abdullah bin Lahi'ah par hai jo hafiza ke ache nahin aur dar hai ke yeh riwayatein marfoo na hon. Chunancha aur sanad se yeh Anas bin Malik (R.A) se mauqoofan marwi hai. Aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke sab bakriyon ke bache is saal ablaq hue siwaye ek bakri ke. Jin sab ko aap le gaye (A.S / Alaihis Salam).

Hazrat Musa aur Shuaib (Alaihimas Salam) ka mu'ahida. In dono bachiyon ki bakriyon ko jab Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne pani pila diya toh yeh apni bakriyan lekar wapas apne ghar gayin. Baap ne dekha ke aaj waqt se pehle yeh aa gayi hain toh daryaft farmaya ke aaj kya baat hai? Unhon ne sacha waqia keh sunaya. Aap ne usi waqt in dono mein se ek ko bheja ke jao aur in ko mere paas le aao. Woh Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke paas aayin aur jis tarah ghar ghar hast pak daman afifa aurton ka dastoor hota hai sharm-o-haya se apni chadar mein lipti hui parde ke sath chal rahi thin. Munh bhi chadar ke kinare se chupaye hue thin phir is danai aur sadaqat ko dekhiye ke sirf yeh nahin kaha ke mere abba aap ko bula rahe hain kyunke is mein shuba ki baton ki gunjaish thi saaf keh diya ke mere walid aap ki mazdoori dene ke liye aur is ehsan ka badla utarne ke liye bula rahe hain. Jo aap ne hamari bakriyon ko pani pilakar hamare sath kiya hai. Kaleemullah ko jo bhooke pyase tan-tanha musafir aur be-kharch thay yeh mauqa ghanimat maloom hua yahan aaye. Inhein ek buzurg samajh kar in ke sawal par apna sara waqia bila-kam-o-kast sunaya. Unhon ne dil joi ki aur farmaya ab kya khauf hai? In zalimon ke hath se aap nikal aaye. Yahan in ki hukumat nahin. Baaz mufassireen kehte hain ke yeh buzurg Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) thay jo Madyan walon ki taraf Allah ke Nabi ban kar aaye hue thay. Yeh mashhoor qaul Imam Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) ka hai aur bohat se ulama bhi yahi farmate hain. Tabrani ki ek hadith mein hai ke jab Hazrat Saad (R.A) apni qaum ki taraf se elchi ban kar Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue toh aap ne farmaya Shuaib ki qaum aur Musa ke susral walon ko marhaba ho ke tumhein hidayat ki gayi. Baaz kehte hain ke yeh Hazrat Shuaib ke bhatije thay koi kehta hai ke qaum-e-Shuaib ke ek momin mard thay. Baaz ka qaul hai ke Shuaib (A.S) ka zamana toh Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke zamane se bohat pehle ka hai. In ka qaul Quran mein apni qaum se yeh marwi hai ke (وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوْطٍ مِّنْكُمْ بِبَعِيْدٍ) (Surah Hud: 89) Loot ki qaum tum se kuch door nahin. Aur yeh bhi Quran se sabit hai ke Lootiyon ki halakat Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah ke zamane mein hui thi. Aur yeh bhi bohat zahir hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim aur Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke darmiyan ka zamana bohat lamba zamana hai. Taqreeban char sau saal ka hai jaise aksar muwarrikheen ka qaul hai han baaz logon ne is mushkil ka yeh jawab diya hai ke Hazrat Shuaib ki bari lambi umar hui thi. In ka maqsad ghaliban is aitraz se bachna hai wallahu a'lam. Ek aur baat bhi khayal mein rahe ke agar yeh buzurg Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) hi hue toh chahiye tha ke Quran mein is mauqa par in ka naam saaf le diya jata. Han albatta baaz ahadees mein yeh aaya hai ke yeh Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) thay. Lekin in ahadees ki sanadein sahih nahin jaise ke hum anqareeb warid karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala, Bani Israel ki kitabon mein in ka naam Thairun batlaya gaya hai wallahu a'lam.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ke sahibzade farmate hain, 'Thairun' Hazrat Shoaib A.S ke bhatije thay. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke yeh 'Yathribi' thay. Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain yeh baat us waqt hoti ke jab is bare mein koi khabar marwi hoti aur aisa hai nahin. Un ki dono sahibzadiyon mein se ek ne baap ki tawajjo dilayi. Yeh tawajjo dilane wali sahibzadi wahi thin jo aap ko bulane gayi thin. Kaha ke inhe aap hamari bakriyon ki charayi par rakh lijiye kyunke woh kaam karne wala achha hota hai jo qawi aur amanat-dar ho. Baap ne beti se poocha tum ne yeh kaise jaan liya ke in mein yeh dono wasf hain? Bachhi ne jawab diya ke das aadmi mil kar jis patthar ko kunwein se hata sakte thay unhone tanha us ko hata diya, un se unki quwwat ka andaza ba-aasani ho sakta hai. Amanat-dari ka ilm mujhe is tarah hua ke jab main inhe le kar aap ke paas aane lagi to is liye ke raaste se na-waqif thay main aage ho li, unhone kaha tum mere peeche raho aur jahan raasta badalna ho us taraf kankar phenk dena main samajh lunga ke mujhe is raaste chalna chahiye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A farmate hain teen shakhs ki si ziraki, mamla-fahami, danayi aur door-bini kisi aur mein nahin payi gayi. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ki danayi ke jab unhone apne baad khilafat ke liye Janab-e-Umar R.A ko muntakhab kiya. Hazrat Yusuf A.S ke khareedne wale Misri jinhone ba-ek-nazar Hazrat Yusuf A.S ko pehchan liya aur ja kar apni biwi se farmaya ke inhe achhi tarah rakho. Aur us buzurg ki sahibzadi jinhone Hazrat Musa A.S ki nisbat apne baap se sifarish ki ke inhe apne kaam par rakh lijiye. Yeh sunte hi us bachhi ke baap ne farmaya ke agar aap pasand karein to main is mehar par in do bachhiyon mein se ek ka nikah aap ke saath kar deta hoon ke aap aath saal tak hamari bakriyan charayein. In dono ka naam Safoora aur Auliya tha ya Safoora aur Sharfa ya Safoora aur Liya. Ashab-e-Abi Hanifa Rahimahullah ne isi se istidlal kiya hai ke jab koi shakhs is tarah ki bai kare ke in do ghulamon mein se ek ko ek sau ke badle farokht karta hoon aur khareedar manzoor kar le to yeh bai sabit aur sahih hai. Wallahu A'lam. Us buzurg ne kaha ke aath saal to zaroori hai is ke baad aap ko ikhtiyar hai das saal ka. Agar aap apni khushi se do saal tak aur bhi mera kaam karein to achha hai warna aap par lazmi nahin. Aap dekhenge ke main bad-aadmi nahin aap ko takleef na doonga. Imam Auza'i ne is se istidlal karke farmaya hai ke agar koi kahe main falan cheez ko naqd das aur udhaar bees par bechta hoon to yeh bai sahih hai aur khareedar ko ikhtiyar hai ke das par naqd le ya bees par udhaar le. Woh is hadith ka bhi yahi matlab le rahe hain jis mein hai jo shakhs do bai ek bai mein kare uske liye kami wali bai hai ya sood. Lekin yeh mazhab gaur-talab hai jis ki tafseel ka yeh maqam nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Ashab-e-Imam Muhammad ne is aayat se istidlal karke kaha hai ke khane peene aur kapde par kisi ko mazdoori aur kaam-kaaj par laga lena durust hai.

Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se sawal kiya ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaun si muddat poori ki thi? To jawab mila ke in dono mein se jo kamil aur mukammal muddat thi. Aik mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) se kisi ne poocha, aap ne Jibraeel (A.S) se poocha, Jibraeel (A.S) ne aur farishtay se, yahan tak ke farishtay ne Allah se. Allah ne jawab diya ke dono mein hi paak aur poori muddat yani das saal.

Ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne das saal ki muddat ka poora karna bataya ke yeh bhi farmaya ke agar tujh se poocha jaye ke kaun si ladki se Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne nikah kiya tha toh jawab dena ke dono mein jo choti thin aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne muddat-e-daraz ko poora karna bataya phir farmaya ke jab Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Hazrat Shuaib (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se rukhsati le kar jaane lage toh apni biwi sahiba se farmaya ke apne walid se kuch bakriyan le lo jin se hamara guzara ho jaye. Aap ne apne walid se sawal kiya jis par unhon ne wada kiya ke is mein se jitni chit kabri bakriyan hongi sab tumhari. Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne bakriyon ke pet par apni lakdi pheri toh har ek ko do-do teen-teen bache hue aur sab ke sab chit kabre jin ki nasl ab tak talash karne se mil sakti hai. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Shuaib (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki sab bakriyan kale rang ki khubsurat thin. Jitne bache un ke is saal hue sab ke sab be-aib the aur bade bade bhare hue thanon wale aur zyada doodh dene wale. In tamam riwayaton ka madar Abdullah bin Lahi'ah par hai jo hafiza ke ache nahin aur dar hai ke yeh riwayatein marfoo na hon. Chunancha aur sanad se yeh Anas bin Malik (R.A) se mauqoofan marwi hai. Aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke sab bakriyon ke bache is saal ablaq hue siwaye ek bakri ke. Jin sab ko aap le gaye (A.S / Alaihis Salam).

Das saal haq-e-mahar: Pehle yeh bayan guzar chuka hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne das saal poore kiye thay. Quran ke is lafz 'Al-Ajal' se bhi is ki taraf ishara hai, Wallahu A'lam. Balkeh Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ka toh qaul hai ke das saal yeh aur das saal aur bhi guzre. Is qaul mein yeh sirf tanha hain, Wallahu A'lam. Ab Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko khayal aur shauq paida hua ke chup-chap watan mein jaaun aur apne walon se mil aaun. Chunancha aap apni biwi sahiba ko aur apni bakriyon ko lekar wahan se chale. Raat ko barish hone lagi aur sard hawayein chalne lagin aur sakht andhera ho gaya. Aap harchand chiragh jalate thay magar roshni nahin hoti thi. Sakht muta'ajib aur hairan thay, itne mein dekhte hain ke kuch door aag roshan hai, toh apni ahliya sahiba se farmaya ke tum yahan thehro, wahan kuch roshni dikhayi deti hai, main wahan jata hoon, agar koi wahan hua toh us se rasta bhi daryaft kar lunga is liye ke hum raah bhoole hue hain. Ya main wahan se kuch aag le aaunga jis se tum taap lo aur jaade ka ilaj ho jaye. Jab aap wahan pahunche toh us wadi ke dayin janib ke maghribi pahar se aawaz sunayi di. Jaise Quran ki aur aayat mein hai (Wama kunta bijanibil gharbi). Is se maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) aag ke qasd se qibla ki taraf chale thay aur maghribi pahar aap ke dayin taraf tha aur ek sarsabz hare bhare darakht mein aag nazar aa rahi thi jo pahar ke daman mein maidan ke mutasil thi. Yeh wahan jakar is halat ko dekh kar hairan-o-shashdar reh gaye ke hare aur sabz darakht mein se aag ke shole nikalte hue dikhayi dete hain lekin aag kisi cheez mein jalti hui dikhayi nahin deti, isi waqt Allah ki taraf se aawaz aayi. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain ke main ne is darakht ko jis mein se Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko aawaz aayi thi dekha hai, woh sarsabz-o-shadab hara bhara darakht hai jo chamak raha hai. Ba'az kehte hain ke yeh 'Aliq' ka darakht tha aur ba'az kehte hain yeh 'Ausaj' ka darakht tha aur aap ki lakri bhi isi darakht ki thi. Kaleemullah (A.S) ne suna ke aawaz aa rahi hai ke 'Aye Musa! Main hoon Rabb-ul-Aalameen, jo is waqt tujh se kalam kar raha hoon. Main jo chahun kar sakta hoon. Mere siwa koi ibadat ke layiq nahin, na mere siwa koi Rabb hai. Main is se paak hoon ke koi mujh jaisa ho, makhlooq mein se koi bhi mera shareek nahin, main yakta aur bemisal hoon aur Wahdahu La Shareeka Lah hoon. Meri zaat, meri sifaat, mere af'aal, mere aqwal mein mera koi shareek, sajhi, saathi nahin. Main har tarah paak aur nuqsan se door hoon.' Isi zimn mein farman hua ke apni lakri zameen par gira do aur meri qudrat apni aankhon se dekh lo. Aur aayat mein hai ke pehle daryaft farmaya gaya ke 'Aye Musa! Tere dayin haath mein kya hai?' Aap ne jawab diya ke 'Yeh meri lakri hai jis se main tek lagata hoon aur jis se apni bakriyon ke liye patte jhaar leta hoon aur dusre bhi mere bahut se kaam is se nikalte hain.' Ab mutala' farmaya ke lakri ko ehsas dilakar phir zameen par unhi ke hathon phankwayi. Woh zameen par girte hi ek phan uthaye phunkarta hua azdaha ban kar idhar udhar farate bharne lagi.

Yeh is baat ki daleel thi ke bolne wala waqai Allah hi hai jo Qadir-e-Mutlaq hai, woh jis cheez ko jo farma de tal nahin sakta. Surah Taha ki tafsir mein is ka bayan bhi poora guzar chuka hai. Is khaufnak saanp ko jo bawajood bahut bada aur bahut mota hone ke teer ki tarah idhar udhar ja raha tha, munh kholta tha to maloom hota tha ke abhi nigal jayega. Jahan se guzarta tha patthar toot jate thay, ise dekh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) seham gaye aur dehshat ke mare thehar na sake, ulte pairon bhage aur mud kar bhi na dekha. Wahin Allah ki taraf se aawaz aayi, "Musa! idhar aa, dar nahin, tu mere amn mein hai." Ab Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka dil thehar gaya. Itminan se be-khauf ho kar wahin apni jagah aa kar ba-adab khade ho gaye. Yeh mojiza ata farma kar phir doosra mojiza yeh diya ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) apna haath apne gareban mein daal kar nikalte to woh chand ki tarah chamakne lagta aur bahut bhala maloom hota, yeh nahin ke korh ke daagh ki tarah safed ho jaye. Yeh bhi ba-hukm-e-Ilahi aap ne wahi kiya aur apne haath ko misl-e-chand munawwar dekh liya. Phir hukm diya ke tumhein is saanp se ya kisi ghabrahat, dar, khauf, ra'ab se dehshat maloom ho to apne bazu apne badan se mila lo, dar khauf jata rahega. Aur yeh bhi hai ke jo shakhs dar aur dehshat ke waqt apna haath apne dil par Allah ke is farman ke matahat rakh le to Insha'Allah us ka khauf dar jata rahega. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke ibtida mein Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke dil par Firaun ka bahut khauf tha, aap jab use dekhte to yeh dua padhte: Dua (Allahumma inni adra'u bika fi nahrihi wa a'uzu bika min sharrihi). "Aye Allah! Main tujhe is ke muqable mein karta hoon aur is ki burai se teri panah mein aata hoon." Allah Ta'ala ne un ke dil se ra'ab-o-khauf hata liya aur Firaun ke dil mein daal diya, phir to us ka yeh haal ho gaya tha ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko dekhte hi us ka peshab khata ho jata tha. Yeh dono mojize yani Asa-e-Musa aur Yad-e-Baiza de kar Allah ne farmaya ke ab Firaun aur Firauniyon ke paas risalat le kar jao aur bator-e-daleel yeh mojiza pesh karo aur in fasiqon ko Allah ki raah dikhao.

Main hoon Rabb-ul-Aalameen, jo is waqt tujh se kalam kar raha hoon. Main jo chahun kar sakta hoon. Mere siwa koi ibadat ke layiq nahin, na mere siwa koi Rabb hai. Main is se paak hoon ke koi mujh jaisa ho, makhlooq mein se koi bhi mera shareek nahin, main yakta aur bemisal hoon aur Wahdahu La Shareeka Lah hoon. Meri zaat, meri sifaat, mere af'aal, mere aqwal mein mera koi shareek, sajhi, saathi nahin. Main har tarah paak aur nuqsan se door hoon.' Isi zimn mein farman hua ke apni lakri zameen par gira do aur meri qudrat apni aankhon se dekh lo. Aur aayat mein hai ke pehle daryaft farmaya gaya ke 'Aye Musa! Tere dayin haath mein kya hai?' Aap ne jawab diya ke 'Yeh meri lakri hai jis se main tek lagata hoon aur jis se apni bakriyon ke liye patte jhaar leta hoon aur dusre bhi mere bahut se kaam is se nikalte hain.' Ab mutala' farmaya ke lakri ko ehsas dilakar phir zameen par unhi ke hathon phankwayi. Woh zameen par girte hi ek phan uthaye phunkarta hua azdaha ban kar idhar udhar farate bharne lagi.

Yeh is baat ki daleel thi ke bolne wala waqai Allah hi hai jo Qadir-e-Mutlaq hai, woh jis cheez ko jo farma de tal nahin sakta. Surah Taha ki tafsir mein is ka bayan bhi poora guzar chuka hai. Is khaufnak saanp ko jo bawajood bahut bada aur bahut mota hone ke teer ki tarah idhar udhar ja raha tha, munh kholta tha to maloom hota tha ke abhi nigal jayega. Jahan se guzarta tha patthar toot jate thay, ise dekh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) seham gaye aur dehshat ke mare thehar na sake, ulte pairon bhage aur mud kar bhi na dekha. Wahin Allah ki taraf se aawaz aayi, "Musa! idhar aa, dar nahin, tu mere amn mein hai." Ab Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka dil thehar gaya. Itminan se be-khauf ho kar wahin apni jagah aa kar ba-adab khade ho gaye. Yeh mojiza ata farma kar phir doosra mojiza yeh diya ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) apna haath apne gareban mein daal kar nikalte to woh chand ki tarah chamakne lagta aur bahut bhala maloom hota, yeh nahin ke korh ke daagh ki tarah safed ho jaye. Yeh bhi ba-hukm-e-Ilahi aap ne wahi kiya aur apne haath ko misl-e-chand munawwar dekh liya. Phir hukm diya ke tumhein is saanp se ya kisi ghabrahat, dar, khauf, ra'ab se dehshat maloom ho to apne bazu apne badan se mila lo, dar khauf jata rahega. Aur yeh bhi hai ke jo shakhs dar aur dehshat ke waqt apna haath apne dil par Allah ke is farman ke matahat rakh le to Insha'Allah us ka khauf dar jata rahega. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke ibtida mein Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke dil par Firaun ka bahut khauf tha, aap jab use dekhte to yeh dua padhte: Dua (Allahumma inni adra'u bika fi nahrihi wa a'uzu bika min sharrihi). "Aye Allah! Main tujhe is ke muqable mein karta hoon aur is ki burai se teri panah mein aata hoon." Allah Ta'ala ne un ke dil se ra'ab-o-khauf hata liya aur Firaun ke dil mein daal diya, phir to us ka yeh haal ho gaya tha ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko dekhte hi us ka peshab khata ho jata tha. Yeh dono mojize yani Asa-e-Musa aur Yad-e-Baiza de kar Allah ne farmaya ke ab Firaun aur Firauniyon ke paas risalat le kar jao aur bator-e-daleel yeh mojiza pesh karo aur in fasiqon ko Allah ki raah dikhao.

Yaad-e-Mazi: Yeh guzar chuka ke Hazrat Musa A.S Firaun se khauf khakar us ke shehar se bhaag nikle thay. Jab Allah Ta'ala ne wahin usi ke paas Nabi bankar jaane ko farmaya toh aap ko woh sab yaad aa gaya aur arz karne lage, "Aye Allah! Un ke ek aadmi ki jaan mere haath se nikal gayi thi, toh aisa na ho ke woh badle ka naam rakh kar mere qatl ke darpay ho jayen." Hazrat Musa A.S ne bachpan ke zamane mein jab ke aap ke saamne bator-e-tajurba ke ek aag aur ek khajoor ya ek moti rakha tha toh aap ne angara pakad liya tha aur munh mein daal liya tha, is waaste aap ki zabaan mein kuch kasar reh gayi thi aur isi liye aap ne apni zabaan ki baabat Allah se dua mangi thi ke meri zabaan ki girah khol de taake log meri baat samajh sakein aur mere bhai Haroon A.S ko mera wazeer banade, is se mera baazu mazboot kar aur use mere kaam mein shareek kar taake Nabuwat-o-Risalat ka fareeza ada ho aur tere bandon ko teri kibriyai ki dawat de sakein.

Yahan bhi aap ki dua manqool hai ke aap ne farmaya, "Mere bhai Haroon ko mere saath hi apna Rasool banakar bhejein, woh mera mu'een-o-wazeer ho jaye. Woh meri baaton ko bawar kare taake mera baazu mazboot rahe, dil badha hua rahe." Aur yeh bhi baat hai ke do aawazein ba-nisbat ek aawaz ke zyada mazboot aur ba-asar hoti hain. "Main akela raha toh darr hai ke kahin woh mujhe jhutla na dein aur Haroon saath hua toh meri baatein bhi logon ko samjha diya karega." Janab-e-Bari Arham-ur-Rahimeen ne jawab diya ke teri maang manzoor hai, hum tere bhai ko tujh ko sahara denge aur use bhi tere saath Nabi banadenge. Jaise aur aayat mein hai: (Qala qad ooteeta su'laka ya Musa 36) (Surah Taha: 36) "Musa! Tera sawal poora kardiya gaya." Aur aayat mein hai, "Hum ne apni rahmat se use us ke bhai Haroon ko Nabi banadiya." Isi liye baaz aslaaf ka farman hai ke kisi bhai ne apne bhai par woh ehsaan nahin kiya jo Hazrat Musa A.S ne Hazrat Haroon A.S par kiya ke Allah se dua karke unhein Nabi banwadiya. Yeh Musa A.S ki badi buzurgi ki daleel hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne un ki aisi dua bhi radd na ki. Waqi'i aap Allah ke nazdeek bade hi martaba wale thay.

Phir farmata hai ke hum tum dono ko zabardast daleelein aur kaamil hujjatein denge, Firauni tumhein koi eeza nahin de sakte. Kyunke tum mera paigham mere bandon ke naam pahunchane wale ho. Aison ko main khud dushmanon se sambhalta hoon. Un ka madadgar aur mu'ayyid main khud ban jata hoon. Anjaam-e-kaar tum aur tumhare manne wale hi ghalib aayenge. Jaise farman hai, "Allah likh chuka hai, main aur mere Rasool hi ghalib aayenge. Allah Ta'ala quwwat wala, izzat wala hai." Aur aayat mein hai: (Inna lanansuru rusulana wallazeena aamanoo fil-hayatid-dunya wa yawma yaqoomul-ash-haad 51) (Surah Ghafir: 51) "Hum apne Rasoolon aur imaan walon ki duniya ki zindagi mein bhi madad karte hain."

Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ke nazdeek aayat ka tarjuma yeh hai ke hamare diye hue ghalbe ki wajah se Firauni tumhein takleef na pahuncha sakenge aur hamari di hui nishaniyon ki wajah se ghalba sirf tumhein hi hasil hoga. Lekin pehle jo matlab bayan hua hai us se bhi yahi sabit hai to is ki koi haajat hi nahin. Wallahu A'lam.

Firauni qoum ka rawayya: Hazrat Musa (A.S) khil'at-e-nabuwwat se aur kalam-e-Ilahi se mumtaz ho kar bahukm-e-Allah Misr mein pohanchay aur Firaun aur Firauniyon ko Allah ki wahdat aur apni risalat ki talqeen ke sath hi jo mojzay Allah ne diye thay unhein dikhaya. Sab ko ma'a Firaun ke yaqeen-e-kamil ho gaya ke beshak Hazrat Musa (A.S) Allah ke Rasool hain. Lekin muddaton ka ghuroor aur purana kufr sar uthaye baghair na raha aur zabanain dil ke khilaf kar ke kehne lagay yeh toh sirf masnooi jadoo hai. Ab Firauni apne dabdabay aur quwwat-o-taqat se haq ke muqablay par jam gaye aur Allah ke nabiyon ka samna karne par tul gaye aur kehne lagay kabhi hum ne toh nahin suna ke Allah ek hai aur hum toh kya hamaray aglay baap dadon ke kaan bhi aashna nahin thay. Hum sab ke sab ma'a apne baray choton ke bohat se maboodon ko poojtay rahay. Yeh nayi baatein le kar kahan se aa gaya? Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne jawab diya ke mujhe aur tum ko Allah khoob janta hai wahi hum tum mein faisla kare ga hum mein se hidayat par kaun hai? Aur kaun naik anjam par hai? Is ka ilm bhi Allah hi ko hai woh faisla kar de ga aur tum anqareeb dekh logay ke Allah ki ta'eed kis ka sath deti hai? Zalim yani mushrik kabhi khush-anjam aur shad-kaam nahin huay woh nijat se mehroom hain.

Firaun ki sarkashi aur us ke ilhami da'we ka zikr ho raha hai ke us ne apni qaum ko be-aqal banakar un se apna da'wa manwa liya. Us ne in kamino ko jama karke haank lagayi ke tumhara Rabb main hi hoon, sab se a'ala aur buland-tar hasti meri hi hai. Isi bina par Allah ne use duniya aur aakhirat ke azabon mein pakad liya aur dusron ke liye use nishan-e-ibrat banaya. In kamino ne use Allah maan kar us ka dimagh yahan tak badha diya ke us ne Kalimullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) se daant kar kaha ke sun agar tu ne mere siwa kisi aur ko apna mabood banaya to main tujhe qaid mein daal dunga. Inhi safle logon mein baith kar apna da'wa unhein manwa kar apne hi jaise apne khabis wazir Haman se kehta hai ke tu ek pazawa (bhatta) bana aur us mein eentein pakwa aur mere liye ek buland-o-bala minar bana ke main jakar jhankun ke waqia mein Musa (A.S) ka koi Allah hai bhi ya nahin. Go mujhe us ke darogh-go hone ka ilm to hai, magar main us ka jhoot tum sab par zahir karna chahta hoon. Isi ka bayan aayat (وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يٰهَامٰنُ ابْنِ لِيْ صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّيْٓ اَبْلُغُ الْاَسْبَابَ 36؀ۙ) (40- Ghafir: 36) mein bhi hai. Chunancha ek buland minar banaya gaya ke us se uncha duniya mein nahin banaya gaya. Yeh Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko na sirf da'wa-e-risalat mein hi jhoot janta tha balkeh yeh to Wahid Bari Ta'ala ka qail hi na tha. Chunancha khud Quran mein hai ke Musa (A.S) se us ne kaha (وَمَا رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ) Rabb-ul-Alameen hai kya? Aur us ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke agar tu ne mere siwa kisi ko Allah jana to main tujhe qaid kardunga. Is aayat mein bhi hai ke us ne apne darbariyon se kaha mere ilm mein bajuz mere tumhara Allah koi aur nahin. Jab us ki aur us ki qaum ki tughyani aur sarkashi had se guzar gayi, Allah ke mulk mein un ke fasad ki koi inteha na rahi, un ke aqeeday khotay paisay jaise hogaye, Qayamat ke hisab-kitab ke bilkul munkir ban baithe to bil-aakhir Allah ka azab un par baras pada aur Rabb ne unhein taak liya aur beej tak mita diya. Sab ko apne azab mein pakad liya aur ek hi din ek hi waqt ek sath darya-burd kardiya. Logo soch lo ke zalimon ka kaisa ibrat-nak anjam hota hai? Hum ne unhein dozakhiyon ka imam banadiya hai ke yeh logon ko un kamon ki taraf bulate hain jin se woh Allah ke azabon mein jalein. Jo bhi un ki raush par chala use woh jahannam mein le gaye, jis ne bhi rasoolon ko jhutlaya aur Allah ko na mana woh un ki raah par hai. Qayamat ke din bhi un ki kuch na chalengi, kahin se unhein koi imdad na pahunchegi, dono jahan mein yeh nuqsan aur ghate mein rahenge, jaise farman hai (اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ 13؀) (47- Muhammad: 13) hum ne unhein teh-o-bala kardiya aur koi un ka madadgar na hua.

Duniya mein bhi yeh mal'oon hue, Allah ki, un farishton ki, un nabiyon ki aur tamam nek bandon ki in par la'nat hai. Jo bhi bhala aadmi in ka naam sunay ga in par phitkar bhejay ga. Duniya mein bhi mal'oon hue aur aakhirat mein bhi qabahat walay honge, jaisay farman hai aayat (Wa utbi'u fi hazihil la'natuw wa yaumal qiyamati bi'sar rifdul marfood) (Surah Hud: 99). Yahan bhi phitkar, wahan bhi la'nat.

Is aayat mein ek lateef baat yeh hai ke Firauniyon ki halakat ke baad wali ummatein is tarah azaab-e-aasmani se halak nahin huin balkay jis ummat ne sarkashi ki us ki sarkashi ka badla usi zamane ke nek logon ke hathon Allah ne usay dilwaya. Momineen mushrikeen se jihad karte rahe jaise farman-e-bari hai aayat (Wa ja'a Firaunu wa man qablahu wal-mu'tafikatu bil-khati'ah) (69. Al-Haqqah: 9) yani Firaun aur jo ummatein us se pehle huin aur ulti hui basti ke rehne wale yani Qaum-e-Lut yeh sab log bade bade qusooron ke murtakib hue aur apne zamane ke rasoolon ki nafarmaniyon par kamar kas li toh Allah Ta'ala ne un sab ko bhi badi sakht pakad se pakad liya. Is giroh ki halakat ke baad bhi Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Kaleem Alaihis Salam min rabbihi afzalus-salatu wat-tasleem par nazil hote rahe jin mein se ek bahut bade inaam ka zikr yahan hai ke unhein Taurat mili. Is Taurat ke nazil hone ke baad kisi qaum ko aasman ke ya zameen ke aam azaab se halak nahin kiya gaya siwaye us basti ke chand mujrimon ke jinhon ne Allah ki hurmat ke khilaf hafte ke din shikar khela tha aur Allah ne unhein suar aur bandar bana diya tha. Yeh waqiya beshak Hazrat Musa A.S ke baad ka hai. Jaise ke Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ne bayan farmaya hai aur is ke baad hi aap ne apne qaul ki shahadat mein yahi aayat (Wa laqad aataina Musal-kitaba mim ba'di ma ahlaknal-qurunal-ula basaira lin-nasi wa hudan wa rahmatal-la'allahum yatadhakkarun) (28. Al-Qasas: 43) ki tilawat farmayi. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa A.S ke baad kisi qaum ko azaab-e-aasmani ya zameeni se halak nahin kiya. Isay azaab jitne aaye aap se pehle aaye. Phir aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Phir Taurat ke ausaf bayan ho rahe hain ke woh kitab ko andhape se gumrahi se nikalne wali thi aur haq ki hidayat karne wali thi. Aur aap ki rahmat se thi nek aamal ki haadi thi. Taake log is se hidayat hasil karein aur nasihat bhi. Aur rah-e-rast par aa jayein.

Daleel-e-Nabuwwat: Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne Nabi-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat ki daleel deta hai ke ek woh shakhs jo ummi ho, jis ne ek harf bhi na padha ho, jo agli kitabon se mahaz na-ashna ho, jis ki qoum ilmi mashagil se aur guzishta tareekh se bilkul be-khabar ho, woh tafseel aur wazahat ke sath, kamal-e-fasahat-o-balaghat ke sath, bilkul sachay, theek aur sahih guzishta waqiyat ko is tarah bayan kare jaise ke us ke apne chashm-deed hon aur jaise ke woh un ke hone ke waqt wahin maujood ho. Kya yeh is amr ki daleel nahin ke woh Allah ki taraf se talqeen kiya jata hai aur Allah Ta'ala khud apni wahi ke zariye se unhein woh tamam baatein batata hai. Hazrat Maryam Siddiqa (R.A) ka waqia bayan farmate hue bhi Quran ne is cheez ko pesh kiya hai aur farmaya hai aayat: (Zalika min anba-il-ghaibi nuhihi ilaika, wa ma kunta ladaihim iz yulquna aqlamahum ayyuhum yakfulu Maryama, wa ma kunta ladaihim iz yakhtasimun) (Surah Al-Imran: 44). Jab ke woh Hazrat Maryam ke paalne ke liye qalmein daal kar faisle kar rahe thay, us waqt to un ke paas maujood na tha aur na to us waqt tha jab ke woh aapas mein jhagad rahe thay. Pas bawajood-e-adam-e-maujoodgi aur be-khabari ke, aap ki nabuwwat ki khari daleel hai aur saaf nishani hai is amr par ke wahi-e-Ilahi se yeh keh rahe hain. Isi tarah Nuh (A.S) ka waqia bayan farma kar farmaya hai aayat: (Tilka min anba-il-ghaibi nuhiha ilaika, ma kunta ta'lamuha anta wa la qawmuka min qabli haza, fasbir, innal-aqibata lil-muttaqin) (Surah Hud: 49). Yeh ghaib ki khabrein hain jinhein hum bazariya-e-wahi ke tum tak pahuncha rahe hain, tu aur teri saari qoum is wahi se pehle in waqiyat se mahaz be-khabar thi. Ab sabr ke sath dekhta reh aur yaqeen maan ke Allah se darte rehne wale hi nek anjam hote hain. Surah Yusuf ke aakhir mein bhi irshad hua hai ke yeh ghaib ki khabrein hain jinhein hum bazariya-e-wahi ke tere paas bhej rahe hain, tu un ke paas us waqt maujood na tha jab ke baradaran-e-Yusuf ne apna musammam irada kar liya tha aur apni tadbeeron mein lag gaye thay. Surah Taha mein aam taur par farmaya aayat: (Kazalika naqussu alaika min anba-i ma qad sabaq, wa qad atainaaka min ladunna zikra) (Surah Taha: 99). Isi tarah hum tere samne pehle ki khabrein bayan farmate hain. Pas yahan bhi Musa (A.S) ki paidaish, un ki nabuwwat ki ibtida wagaira awwal se aakhir tak bayan farma kar farmaya ke tum ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) maghribi pahad ki janib jahan ke mashriqi darakht mein se jo wadi ke kinare thay, Allah ne apne Kaleem se baatein keen, maujood na thay, balkeh Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ne apni wahi ke zariye aap ko yeh sab maloomat karayin. Taake yeh aap ki nabuwwat ki ek daleel ho jaye un zamano par jo muddaton se chale aa rahe hain aur Allah ki baaton ko woh bhool bhaal chuke hain.

Agle nabiyon ki wahi un ke hathon se gum ho chuki hai aur na tu Madyan mein rehta tha ke wahan ke nabi Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) ki halat bayan karta jo un mein aur un ki qoum mein waqay hue thay. Balkay hum ne bazariya-e-wahi yeh khabrein tumhein pohanchayin aur tamam jahan ki taraf tujhe apna rasool bana kar bheja. Aur na tu Toor ke paas tha jab ke hum ne aawaz di. Nasai Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh aawaz di gayi ke aye ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ) tum is se pehle mujh se mango main ne tumhein de diya aur is se pehle tum mujh se dua karo main qabool kar chuka. Muqatil kehte hain ke hum ne teri ummat ko jo abhi baap dadon ki peeth mein thi aawaz di ke jab tu nabi bana kar bheja jaye to woh teri itteba karein. Qatada farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke hum ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko aawaz di, yahi zyada mushaba aur mutabiq hai kyunke oopar bhi yahi zikr hai. Oopar aam tor par bayan tha yahan khaas tor se zikr hai jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa iz nada rabbuka musa anitil qawmaz zalimeen) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 10) ko aawaz di aur aayat mein hai ke wadi-e-muqaddas mein Allah ne apne kaleem ko pukara. Aur aayat mein hai ke Toor-e-Aiman ki taraf se hum ne usay pukara aur sargoshiyan karte hue usay apna qurb ata farmaya. Phir farmata hai ke in mein se ek waqya bhi na teri haziri ka hai na tera chashm-deed hai balkay yeh Allah ki wahi hai jo woh apni rahmat se tujh par farma rahe hain aur yeh bhi us ki rahmat hai ke us ne tujhe apne bandon ki taraf nabi bana kar bheja. Ke tu in logon ko aagah aur hoshiyar kar de jin ke paas tujh se pehle koi nabi nahin aaya taake nasihat hasil karein aur hidayat payein. Aur is liye bhi ke in ki daleel baqi na reh jaye aur koi uzr in ke hath mein na rahe aur yeh apne kufr ki wajah se azabon ko aata dekh kar yeh na keh sakein ke in ke paas koi rasool aaya hi na tha jo unhein rah-e-rast ki taleem deta aur jaise ke apni mubarak kitab Quran-e-Kareem ke nazool ko bayan farma kar farmaya ke yeh is liye hai ke tum yeh na keh sako ke kitab to hum se pehle ki dono jamaat par utarti thi lekin hum to is ki dars-o-tadrees se bilkul ghafil thay agar hum par kitab nazil hoti to yaqeenan hum un se zyada rah-e-rast par aa jate. Ab batao ke khud tumhare paas bhi tumhare Rab ki daleel aur hidayat-o-rahmat aa chuki. Aur aayat mein hai rasool hain khushkhabriyan dene wale darane wale taake in rasoolon ke baad kisi ki koi hujjat Allah par baqi na reh jaye. Is hamari utari hui mubarak kitab ki tum pairwi karo Allah se daro taake tum par raham kiya jaye. Jis shakhs ne gha'ir nazar se ilm-e-deen ka mutala'a kiya hai us par yeh baat bilkul zahir hai ke aasmani kitabon mein sab se zyada azmat-o-sharafat wali izzat-o-karamat wali kitab to yahi Quran-e-Majeed Furqan-e-Hameed hai jo Allah Ta'ala Hameed-o-Majeed ne apne Rauf-o-Raheem Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par nazil farmayi. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke murad Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain, lekin is teesre qaul mein toh bahut hi bu'd hai aur dusre qaul se bhi pehla qaul mazboot aur umda hai aur bahut qawi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh matlab saahiran ki qira'at par hai aur jin ki qira'at sihran hai woh kehte hain murad Taurat aur Injeel hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam bis-Sawab. Lekin is qira'at par bhi zahiri Taurat-o-Quran ke ma'ani theek hain kyunke is ke baad hi farman-e-Allah hai ke tum hi in dono se zyada hidayat wali koi kitab Allah ke haan se lao jis ki main tabedari karoon. Taurat aur Quran ko aksar ek hi jagah mein bayan farmaya gaya hai.

Jaise farmaya aayat (Qul man anzalal-kitaballazi ja'a bihi Musa nuran wa hudan lin-nasi taj'alunahu qaratisa tubdunaha wa tukhfuna kathiran wa 'ullimtum ma lam ta'lamu antum wa la aba'ukum, qulillahu thumma dharhum fi khawdihim yal'abun) (6. Al-An'am: 91). Pas yahan Taurat ke nur-o-hidayat hone ka zikr farma kar phir farmaya aayat (Wa hadha kitabun anzalnahu mubarakun fattabi'uhu wattaqu la'allakum turhamun) (6. Al-An'am: 155). Aur is kitab ko bhi hum ne hi babarakat bana kar utara hai. Aur surat ke aakhir mein farmaya (Thumma atayna Musal-kitaba tamaman 'alalladhi ahsana wa tafsilan likulli shai'in wa hudan wa rahmatan la'allahum biliqa'i rabbihim yu'minun) (6. Al-An'am: 154). Phir hum ne Musa ko kitab di aur farman hai (Wa hadha kitabun anzalnahu mubarakun fattabi'uhu wattaqu la'allakum turhamun) (6. Al-An'am: 155). Is hamari utari hui mubarak kitab ki tum pairwi karo Allah se daro taake tum par raham kiya jaye. Jinnat ka qaul Quran mein hai ke unhon ne kaha hum ne woh kitab suni jo Musa ke baad utari gayi hai jo apne se pehle ki aur ilhami kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wali hai. Waraqa bin Naufal ka maqula hadith ki kitabon mein marwi hai ke unhon ne kaha tha yeh wohi Allah ke raaz-dan bhi di hai jo Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke baad aap ki taraf bheje gaye hain. Jis shakhs ne gha'ir nazar se ilm-e-deen ka mutala'a kiya hai us par yeh baat bilkul zahir hai ke aasmani kitabon mein sab se zyada azmat-o-sharafat wali izzat-o-karamat wali kitab to yahi Quran-e-Majeed Furqan-e-Hameed hai jo Allah Ta'ala Hameed-o-Majeed ne apne Rauf-o-Raheem Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par nazil farmayi. Is ke baad Taurat-e-Sharif ka darja hai jis mein hidayat-o-nur tha jis ke mutabiq ambiya aur un ke mat-hat hukm-e-ahkam jari karte rahe. Injeel to sirf Taurat ko tamam karne wali aur ba'az haram ko halal karne wali thi is liye farmaya ke in dono kitabon se behtar kitab agar tum Allah ke haan se lao to main us ki tabedari karunga. Phir farmaya ke jo aap kehte hain woh bhi agar yeh na karein aur na aap ki tabedari karein to jaan le ke darasal inhein daleel-o-burhan ki koi haajat hi nahin. Yeh sirf jhagralu hain aur khwahish parast hain. Aur zahir hai ke khwahish ke paband logon se jo Allah ki hidayat se khali hon barh kar koi zalim nahin. Is mein inhimak kar ke jo log apni jaanon par zulm karein woh aakhir tak rah-e-rast se mehroom reh jate hain. Hum ne un ke liye tafsili qaul bayan kar diya wazeh kar diya saaf kar diya agli pichli baatein bayan kar dein Quraishon ke samne sab kuch zahir kar diya. Ba'az murad is se Rifa'a lete hain aur un ke sath ke aur nau aadmi. Yeh Rifa'a Hazrat Safiya bint-e-Huyay ke mamu hain jinhon ne Tamimiya bin Wahb ko talaq di thi jin ka dusra nikah Abdur-Rahman bin Zubair se hua tha.

Ahl-e-Kitab ulama Ahl-e-Kitab ke ulama darhaqiqat Allah ke dost thay un ke pakeeza ausaf bayan ho rahe hain ke woh Quran ko maante hain jaise farman hai jinhein hum ne kitab di hai aur woh samajh boojh kar parhte hain un ka toh is Quran par iman hai. Aur ayat mein hai ke baaz Ahl-e-Kitab aise bhi hain jo Allah ko maan kar tumhari taraf nazil shuda kitab aur apni taraf utri hui kitab ko bhi maante hain aur Allah se darte rehte hain. Aur jagah hai pehle ke Ahl-e-Kitab aise bhi hain ke hamare is Quran ki ayatein sun kar sajdon mein gir parte hain aur zaban se kehte hain ke dua (وَّيَـقُوْلُوْنَ سُبْحٰنَ رَبِّنَآ اِنْ كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُوْلًا) (17. Al-Isra: 108) aur ayat mein hai (وَلَتَجِدَنَّ اَقْرَبَهُمْ مَّوَدَّةً لِّلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا نَصٰرٰى ۭذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ مِنْهُمْ قِسِّيْسِيْنَ وَرُهْبَانًا وَّاَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 82) yani musalmanon ke sath dosti ke aitbar se sab logon se qareeb tar unhein paoge jo apne tayein Nasara kehte hain is liye ke un mein ulama aur mashaikh thay jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein Najashi Habsha ke bheje hue aaye thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein Surah Yaseen sunayi jise sun kar yeh rone lage aur musalman ho gaye. Inhi ke bare mein yeh ayatein utrin ke yeh unhein sunte hi apne muwahid mukhlis hone ka iqrar karte hain aur qabool karke momin muslim ban jate hain. Un ki in siftaton par Allah bhi unhein dohra ajar deta hai ek pehli kitab ko manne ka dusra Quran ko tasleem karne wa tameel ka. Yeh itteba-e-haq par sabit qadmi karte hain jo darasal ek mushkil aur ahem kaam hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke teen qisam ke logon ko dohra ajar milta hai Ahl-e-Kitab jo apne Nabi ko maan kar phir mujh par bhi iman laye. Ghulam mamlook jo apne majazi aaqa ki farman bardari ke sath Allah Ta'ala ke haq ki adaigi bhi karta rahe aur woh shakhs jis ke paas koi laundi ho jise woh adab-o-ilm sikhaye phir azad kare aur us se nikah karle. Qasim bin Abu Umamah (R.A) kehte hain Fatah-e-Makkah wale din mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sawari ke sath hi aur bilkul paas hi tha. Aap ne bahut behtareen baatein irshad farmayin jin mein yeh bhi farmaya ke Yahood-o-Nasara mein jo musalman ho jaye use dohra dohra ajar hai aur us ke aam musalmanon ke barabar haqooq hain. Phir un ke nek ausaf bayan ho rahe hain ke yeh burai ka badla burai se nahin lete balkay maaf kardete hain. Darguzar kardete hain. Aur nek sulook hi karte hain aur apni halal roziyan Allah ke naam kharch karte hain apne baal bachon ka pet bhi palte hain zakat, sadaqat-o-khairat mein bhi bakhili nahin karte. Laghwiyat se bache hue rehte hain. Aise logon se dostiyan nahin karte aisi majlison se door rehte hain balkay agar achanak guzar ho bhi jaye toh buzurgana taur par hat jate hain aison se mel jol ulfat mohabbat nahin karte saaf keh dete hain ke tumhari karni tumhare sath hamare aamal hamare sath.

Ya'ni jahilon ki sakht kalam-i bardasht kar lete hain, unhein aisa jawab nahin dete ke woh aur bhadkein, balkeh chashm-poshi kar lete hain aur katra kar nikal jate hain. Chunkeh khud pak nafs hain is liye pakeeza kalam hi munh se nikalte hain. Keh dete hain ke tum par salam ho, hum na jahilana raush par chalein na jahalat ki chaal ko pasand karein. Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H farmate hain ke Habsha se Huzoor-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas taqreeban bees Nasrani aaye. Aap us waqt masjid mein tashreef farma thay, yahin yeh bhi baith gaye aur baat-cheet shuru ki. Us waqt Quraishi apni apni baithkon mein Ka'aba ke gird-o-pesh baithe hue thay. In Isai ulama ne jab sawalat kar liye aur jawabat se unki tashaffi ho gayi to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Deen-e-Islam unke samne pesh kiya aur Quran-e-Kareem ki tilawat karke unhein sunayi. Chunkeh yeh log padhe likhe, sanjeeda aur roshan dimagh thay, Quran ne unke dilon par asar kiya aur unki aankhon se aansu behne lage. Unhon ne foran Deen-e-Islam qabool kar liya aur Allah par aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman laye. Kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jo sifatein unhon ne apni aasmani kitabon mein padhi thin, sab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein majood payein. Jab yeh log Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas se jane lage to Abu Jahl bin Hisham mal'oon apne aadmiyon ko liye hue unhein raste mein mila aur tamam Quraishiyon ne mil kar unhein ta'ane dene shuru kiye aur bura kehne lage ke tum se badtareen wafd kisi qoum ka hum ne nahin dekha. Tumhari qoum ne tumhein is shakhs ke halat maloom karne ke liye bheja, yahan tum ne aabai mazhab ko chhod diya aur iska aisa rang tum par chadh gaya ke zara si der mein apne deen ko tark karke deen badal diya aur isi ka kalma padhne lage, tum se zyada ahmaq hum ne kisi ko nahin dekha. Unhon ne thande dil se yeh sab sun liya aur jawab diya ke hum tumhare sath jahilana baatein karna pasand nahin karte, hamara deen hamare sath, tumhara mazhab tumhare sath. Hum ne jis baat mein apni bhalai dekhi use qabool kar liya. Yeh bhi kaha jata hai ke yeh wafd Najran ke Nasraniyon ka tha, Wallahu A'alam. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh aayatein inhi ke bare mein utri hain. Hazrat Zuhri R.H se in aayaton ka shaan-e-nuzool poocha gaya to Aap (R.H) ne farmaya: Main to apne ulama se yahi sunta chala aaya hoon ke yeh aayatein Najashi aur unke as-haab (R.A) ke bare mein utri hain. Aur Surah Ma'idah ki aayatein (Zalika bi-anna minhum qissisina wa ruhbana wa annahum la yastakbirun) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 82) tak ki aayatein bhi inhi ke bare mein nazil hui hain.
