Chunkeh khud pak nafs hain is liye pakeeza kalam hi munh se nikalte hain. Keh dete hain ke tum par salam ho, hum na jahilana raush par chalein na jahalat ki chaal ko pasand karein. Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H farmate hain ke Habsha se Huzoor-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas taqreeban bees Nasrani aaye. Aap us waqt masjid mein tashreef farma thay, yahin yeh bhi baith gaye aur baat-cheet shuru ki. Us waqt Quraishi apni apni baithkon mein Ka'aba ke gird-o-pesh baithe hue thay. In Isai ulama ne jab sawalat kar liye aur jawabat se unki tashaffi ho gayi to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Deen-e-Islam unke samne pesh kiya aur Quran-e-Kareem ki tilawat karke unhein sunayi. Chunkeh yeh log padhe likhe, sanjeeda aur roshan dimagh thay, Quran ne unke dilon par asar kiya aur unki aankhon se aansu behne lage. Unhon ne foran Deen-e-Islam qabool kar liya aur Allah par aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman laye. Kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jo sifatein unhon ne apni aasmani kitabon mein padhi thin, sab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein majood payein. Jab yeh log Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas se jane lage to Abu Jahl bin Hisham mal'oon apne aadmiyon ko liye hue unhein raste mein mila aur tamam Quraishiyon ne mil kar unhein ta'ane dene shuru kiye aur bura kehne lage ke tum se badtareen wafd kisi qoum ka hum ne nahin dekha. Tumhari qoum ne tumhein is shakhs ke halat maloom karne ke liye bheja, yahan tum ne aabai mazhab ko chhod diya aur iska aisa rang tum par chadh gaya ke zara si der mein apne deen ko tark karke deen badal diya aur isi ka kalma padhne lage, tum se zyada ahmaq hum ne kisi ko nahin dekha. Unhon ne thande dil se yeh sab sun liya aur jawab diya ke hum tumhare sath jahilana baatein karna pasand nahin karte, hamara deen hamare sath, tumhara mazhab tumhare sath. Hum ne jis baat mein apni bhalai dekhi use qabool kar liya. Yeh bhi kaha jata hai ke yeh wafd Najran ke Nasraniyon ka tha, Wallahu A'alam. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh aayatein inhi ke bare mein utri hain. Hazrat Zuhri R.H se in aayaton ka shaan-e-nuzool poocha gaya to Aap (R.H) ne farmaya: Main to apne ulama se yahi sunta chala aaya hoon ke yeh aayatein Najashi aur unke as-haab (R.A) ke bare mein utri hain. Aur Surah Ma'idah ki aayatein (Zalika bi-anna minhum qissisina wa ruhbana wa annahum la yastakbirun) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 82) tak ki aayatein bhi inhi ke bare mein nazil hui hain.

Ahl-e-Kitab ulama Ahl-e-Kitab ke ulama darhaqiqat Allah ke dost thay un ke pakeeza ausaf bayan ho rahe hain ke woh Quran ko maante hain jaise farman hai jinhein hum ne kitab di hai aur woh samajh boojh kar parhte hain un ka toh is Quran par iman hai. Aur ayat mein hai ke baaz Ahl-e-Kitab aise bhi hain jo Allah ko maan kar tumhari taraf nazil shuda kitab aur apni taraf utri hui kitab ko bhi maante hain aur Allah se darte rehte hain. Aur jagah hai pehle ke Ahl-e-Kitab aise bhi hain ke hamare is Quran ki ayatein sun kar sajdon mein gir parte hain aur zaban se kehte hain ke dua (وَّيَـقُوْلُوْنَ سُبْحٰنَ رَبِّنَآ اِنْ كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُوْلًا) (17. Al-Isra: 108) aur ayat mein hai (وَلَتَجِدَنَّ اَقْرَبَهُمْ مَّوَدَّةً لِّلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا نَصٰرٰى ۭذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ مِنْهُمْ قِسِّيْسِيْنَ وَرُهْبَانًا وَّاَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 82) yani musalmanon ke sath dosti ke aitbar se sab logon se qareeb tar unhein paoge jo apne tayein Nasara kehte hain is liye ke un mein ulama aur mashaikh thay jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein Najashi Habsha ke bheje hue aaye thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein Surah Yaseen sunayi jise sun kar yeh rone lage aur musalman ho gaye. Inhi ke bare mein yeh ayatein utrin ke yeh unhein sunte hi apne muwahid mukhlis hone ka iqrar karte hain aur qabool karke momin muslim ban jate hain. Un ki in siftaton par Allah bhi unhein dohra ajar deta hai ek pehli kitab ko manne ka dusra Quran ko tasleem karne wa tameel ka. Yeh itteba-e-haq par sabit qadmi karte hain jo darasal ek mushkil aur ahem kaam hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke teen qisam ke logon ko dohra ajar milta hai Ahl-e-Kitab jo apne Nabi ko maan kar phir mujh par bhi iman laye. Ghulam mamlook jo apne majazi aaqa ki farman bardari ke sath Allah Ta'ala ke haq ki adaigi bhi karta rahe aur woh shakhs jis ke paas koi laundi ho jise woh adab-o-ilm sikhaye phir azad kare aur us se nikah karle. Qasim bin Abu Umamah (R.A) kehte hain Fatah-e-Makkah wale din mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sawari ke sath hi aur bilkul paas hi tha. Aap ne bahut behtareen baatein irshad farmayin jin mein yeh bhi farmaya ke Yahood-o-Nasara mein jo musalman ho jaye use dohra dohra ajar hai aur us ke aam musalmanon ke barabar haqooq hain. Phir un ke nek ausaf bayan ho rahe hain ke yeh burai ka badla burai se nahin lete balkay maaf kardete hain. Darguzar kardete hain. Aur nek sulook hi karte hain aur apni halal roziyan Allah ke naam kharch karte hain apne baal bachon ka pet bhi palte hain zakat, sadaqat-o-khairat mein bhi bakhili nahin karte. Laghwiyat se bache hue rehte hain. Hidayat sirf Allah ke zimme hai. Aye Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kisi ka hidayat qabool karna tumhare qabze ki cheez nahin. Aap par toh sirf paigham-e-Allah ke pahuncha dene ka fareeza hai. Hidayat ka maalik Allah hai, woh apni hikmat ke sath jise chahe qabool-e-hidayat ki taufeeq bakhshta hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Laisa alaika hudahum) tere zimme in ki hidayat nahin, woh chahe toh hidayat bakhshe. Aur aayat mein hai (Wama aksarun-nasi walau harasta bimu'mineen) (12. Yusuf: 103) go tu har-chand tama' kare lekin in mein se aksar imandar nahin hote, ke yeh Allah ke hi ilm mein hai ke mustahiq-e-hidayat kaun hai? Aur mustahiq-e-zalalat kaun hai? Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke yeh aayat aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chacha Abu Talib ke bare mein utri jo aap ka bahut taraf-dar tha aur har mauqe par aap ki madad karta tha aur aap ka sath deta tha aur dil se mohabbat karta tha, lekin yeh mohabbat ba-wajah-e-rishtedari ke tab'i thi shar'an na thi. Jab us ki maut ka waqt qareeb aaya toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne use Islam ki dawat di aur iman lane ki raghbat dilayi, lekin taqdeer ka likha aur Allah ka chaha ghalib aa gaya, yeh hathon mein se phisal gaya aur apne kufr par ada raha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ke inteqal par us ke paas aaye. Abu Jahl aur Abdullah bin Umayyah bhi us ke paas baithe hue the, aap ne farmaya La ilaha illallah kaho, main is ki wajah se Allah ke han tera sifarishi ban jaunga. Abu Jahl aur Abdullah kehne lage, Abu Talib kya tu apne baap Abdul Muttalib ke mazhab se phir jayega? Ab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) samjhate aur woh dono use rokte, yahan tak ke aakhir kalma us ki zaban se yahi nikla ke main yeh kalma nahin padhta aur main Abdul Muttalib ke mazhab par hoon. Aap ne farmaya behtar, main tere liye Rabb se istighfar karta rahunga, yeh aur baat hai ke main rok diya jaun, Allah mujhe mana farma de. Lekin isi waqt aayat utri ke (Ma kana lin-nabiyyi walladhina amanu an yastaghfiru lil-mushrikina walau kanu uli qurba mim ba'di ma tabayyana lahum annahum as-habul jahim) (9. At-Taubah: 113) yani Nabi ko aur momin ko hargiz yeh baat sazawar nahin ke woh mushrikon ke liye istighfar karein, go woh un ke nazdiki qarabatdar hi kyun na hon. Aur isi Abu Talib ke bare mein aayat (Innaka la tahdi man ahbabta walakinnallaha yahdi man yashau wa huwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen) (28. Al-Qasas: 56) bhi nazil hui (Sahih Muslim waghaira). Tirmidhi waghaira mein hai ke Abu Talib ke marz-ul-maut mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us se kaha ke chacha La ilaha illallah keh lo, main is ki gawahi Qayamat ke din de dunga. Toh us ne kaha agar mujhe apne khandan-e-Quraish ke is ta'ane ka khauf na ho - us ne maut ki ghabrahat ki wajah se yeh keh liya - toh main ise keh kar teri aankhon ko thandi kar deta, magar phir bhi ise teri khushi ke liye kehta hoon. Is par yeh aayat utri. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke us ne kalma padhne se saaf inkar kar diya aur kaha ke mere bhatije main toh apne badon ki raush par hoon.

Aur isi baat par us ki maut hui ke woh Abdul Muttalib ke mazhab par hai. Qaisar ka qasid jab Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur Qaisar ka khat khidmat-e-Nabvi mein pesh kiya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne use apni god mein rakh kar farmaya tu kis qabeelay se hai? Us ne kaha Tairaj qabeelay ka aadmi hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke tera qasd hai ke tu apne baap Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke deen par aajaye? Us ne jawab diya ke main jis qoum ka qasid hoon jab tak un ke paigham ka jawab unhein na pohancha doon un ke mazhab ko nahin chhor sakta. Toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne muskura kar apne sahaba ki taraf dekh kar yahi aayat parhi. Mushrikeen apne imaan na lanay ki aik wajah yeh bhi bayan karte thay ke hum Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki layi hui hidayat ko maan lein toh hamein dar lagta hai ke is deen ke mukhalif jo hamaray charon taraf hain aur tadaad mein maal mein hum se zyada hain. Woh hamaray dushman ban jayenge aur hamein takleefein pohanchayengi aur hamein barbad kar dengay. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke yeh heela bhi un ka ghalat hai. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein Haram-e-Mohtaram mein rakha hai jahan shuru duniya se ab tak aman-o-aman raha hai toh yeh kaisay ho sakta hai ke halat-e-kufr mein toh yahan aman se rahein aur jab Allah Ta'ala ke sachay deen ko qabool karein toh aman uth jaye? Yahi toh woh shehar hai ke Taif waghera mukhtalif maqamat se phal fruit, saman, asbaab, maal-e-tijarat waghera ki aamad-o-raft bakasrat rehti hai. Tamam cheezein yahan khinchi chali aati hain aur hum unhein bethay bithaye roziyan pohancha rahay hain lekin in mein aksar be-ilm hain. Isi liye aisay rakeek heelay aur be-ja uzr pesh karte hain. Marwi hai ke yeh kehne wala Haris bin Aamir bin Naufal tha.

Ahl-e-Makkah ko tanbeeh. Ahl-e-Makkah ko hoshiyar kiya jata hai ke jo Allah ki bahut si ne'matein hasil karke utra rahe thay aur sarkashi aur badai karte thay aur Allah se kufr karte thay, Nabi ka inkar karte thay aur Allah ki roziyan khate thay aur uski namak harami karte thay, unhein Allah Ta'ala ne is tarah tabah-o-barbad kardiya ke aaj unka naam lene wala nahin raha. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa daraballahu masalan qaryatan kanat aminatan mutma'innatan ya'tiha rizquha raghadan min kulli makanin fakafarat bi-an'umillahi fa-azaqahallahu libasal ju'i wal khawfi bima kanu yasna'un) (Surah An-Nahl: 112). Yahan farmata hai ke unki ujdi hui bastiyan ab tak ujdi padi hain. Kuch yunhi si abadi agarche ho gayi ho lekin dekho unke khandrat se aaj tak wehshat baras rahi hai, hum hi unke malik reh gaye hain. Hazrat Ka'ab (Tabi'i) R.H ka qaul hai ke ullu se Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne daryaft farmaya ke tu kheti anaaj kyun nahin khata? Usne kaha ke isliye ke isi ke ba'is Hazrat Adam A.S jannat se nikale gaye. Pucha paani kyun nahin peeta? Kaha isliye ke qaum-e-Nuh A.S isi mein dubodi gayi. Pucha veerane mein kyun rehta hai? Kaha isliye ke woh Allah ki meeras hai. Phir Hazrat Ka'ab R.H ne aayat (Wa kunna nahnul warithin) (Surah Al-Qasas: 58) padha. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne adl-o-insaf ko bayan farma raha hai ke woh kisi ke zulm se halak nahin karta, pehle un par apni hujjat khatam karta hai aur unka uzr door karta hai. Rasoolon ko bhej kar apna kalam un tak pahunchata hai. Is aayat se yeh bhi maloom hota hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ki nabuwwat aam thi, aap Umm-ul-Qura mein mab'oos hue thay aur tamam Arab-o-Ajam ki taraf Rasool bana kar bheje gaye thay, jaise farman hai aayat (Litunzira Ummal Qura wa man hawlaha) taake tu Makkah walon ko aur dusre shehar walon ko dara de aur farmaya aayat (Qul ya ayyuhan-nasu inni Rasoolullahi ilaikum jami'anillazi lahu mulkus-samawati wal ardi, la ilaha illa huwa yuhyi wa yumitu fa-aminu billahi wa Rasulihi-nabiyyil ummiyyillazi yu'minu billahi wa kalimatihi wattabi'uhu la'allakum tahtadun) (Surah Al-A'raf: 158) keh de ke ae logo! Aur aayat mein hai (Wa man yakfuru bihi minal ahzabi fannaru maw'iduhu) (Surah Hud: 17) is Quran ke sath duniya walon mein se jo bhi kufr karein uske wade ki jagah jahannam hai. Duniya aur Akhirat ka taqabuli jaiza: Allah Ta'ala duniya ki haqarat, is ki raunaq ki qillat-o-zillat, is ki na-paidari, be-sabati aur burai bayan farma raha hai aur is ke muqable mein Akhirat ki nematon ki paidari, dawam, azmat aur qayam ka zikr farma rahe hain. Jaise irshad hai ayat: (Ma indakum yanfadu wa ma indallahi baqin, wa lanajziyannallazina sabaru ajrahum bi-ahsani ma kanu ya'malun) (16. An-Nahl: 96). Tumhare paas jo kuch hai fana hone wala hai aur Allah ke paas tamam cheezein baqa wali hain. Allah ke paas jo hai woh nek logon ke liye bahut hi behtar aur umda hai. Akhirat ke muqable mein duniya toh kuch bhi nahin. Lekin afsos ke log duniya ke peeche pade hue hain aur Akhirat se ghafil ho rahe hain jo bahut behtar aur bahut baqi rehne wali hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain duniya Akhirat ke muqable mein aisi hai jaise tum mein se koi samundar mein ungli dabo kar nikal le phir dekh le ke is ki ungli par jo pani chadha hua hai woh samundar ke muqable mein kitna kuch hai. Afsos ke is par bhi aksar log apni kam-ilmi aur be-ilmi ke ba'is duniya ke matwale ho rahe hain. Khayal kar lo ek toh woh jo Allah par, Allah ke Nabi par iman-o-yaqeen rakhta ho aur ek woh jo iman na laya ho, natije ke aitbar se barabar ho sakte hain? Iman walon ke sath toh Allah ka Jannat ka aur apni beshumar an-mit ghair-fani nematon ka wada hai aur kafir ke sath wahan ke azabon ka darawa hai go duniya mein kuch roz aish hi mana le. Marwi hai ke yeh ayat Huzoor (ﷺ) aur Abu Jahl ke bare mein nazil hui, ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke Hamza (R.A), Ali (R.A) aur Abu Jahl ke bare mein yeh ayat utri hai. Zahir yeh hai ke yeh ayat aam hai jaise farman-e-Allah hai ke Jannati momin apne Jannat ke darjon se jhank kar jahannami kafir ko jahannam ke jail khane mein dekh kar kahe ga: (Wa lau la ni'matu rabbi la kuntu minal muhdarina) (37. As-Saffat: 57). Agar mujh par mere Rabb ka in'am na hota toh main bhi in azabon mein phans jata. Aur ayat mein hai: (Wa laqad 'alimatil jinnatu innahum lamuhdarun) (37. As-Saffat: 158). Jinnat ko yaqeen hai ke woh hazir kiye jane walon mein se hain.

Kahan hain tumhare but? Mushrikon ko Qayamat ke din pukar kar samne khara karke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmaye ga ke duniya mein jinhein tum mere siwa poojte rahe, jin buton aur pattharon ko maante rahe ho woh kahan hain? Unhein pukaro aur dekho ke woh tumhari kuch madad karte hain? Ya woh khud apni koi madad kar sakte hain? Yeh sirf bator-e-daant-dupat ke hoga. Jaise farman hai ayat (Walaqad ji'tumuna furada kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin wa taraktum ma khawwalnakum wara'a zuhurikum, wa ma nara ma'akum shufa'akumullazina za'amtum annahum feekum shuraka'u, laqad taqatta'a bainakum wa dalla 'ankum ma kuntum taz'umun) (Surah Al-An'am: 94) yani hum tumhein waise hi tan-tanha aur ek-ek karke layenge jaise hum ne awwal dafa paida kiya tha aur jo kuch hum ne tumhein yaad dilaya tha woh sab tum apne peeche hi chhor aaye. Hum to aaj tumhare sath kisi safarishi ko bhi nahin dekhte jinhein tum shareek-e-Ilahi thiraye hue thay. Tum mein un mein koi lagao nahin raha aur tumhare guman karda shareek sab aaj tum se khoye hue hain. Jin par azab ki baat sabit ho chuki yani shayateen aur sarkash log aur kufr ke bani aur shirk ki taraf logon ko bulane wale, yeh sab bade-bade log us din kahenge ke ae Allah hum ne inhein gumrah kiya aur unhon ne hamari kufriya baatein sunin aur manin, jaise hum behke hue thay unhein bhi behkaya. Hum un ki ibadat se tere samne apni bezari ka izhar karte hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Wattakhazu min dunillahi alihatan liyakunu lahum 'izza) (Surah Maryam: 81) unhon ne Allah ke siwa aur mabood bana liye taake woh un ke liye ba'is-e-izzat banein, lekin aisa nahin hone ka, yeh to unki ibadat se bhi inkar kar jayenge aur ulte un ke dushman ban jayenge. Aur ayat mein hai (Wa man adallu mimman yad'u min dunillahi mal la yastajeebu lahu ila yawmil qiyamati wahum 'an du'a'ihim ghafilun) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 5) us se barh kar gumrah kaun hai jo Allah ke siwa dusron ko pukarta hai jo Qayamat ki ghari tak unhein jawab na de sakein aur woh un ki pukar se bhi ghafil hon aur Qayamat ke din logon ke hashr ke mauqa par un ke dushman ban jayenge aur is baat se saaf inkar kar denge ke unhon ne unki ibadat ki thi. Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne apni qaum se farmaya tha ke tum ne jin buton ki pooja-paat shuru kar rakhi hai un se sirf duniya ki hi dosti hai, Qayamat ke din to tum sab ek dusre ke munkir ho jaoge aur ek dusre par la'nat bhejoge. Aur ayat mein hai (Iz tabarra'allazina tubbi'u minallazina taba'u wa ra'awul 'azaba wa taqatta'at bihimul asbab) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 166).

(Al-Baqarah: 166) Ya'ni jo tabedari karne wale thay aur woh unki purjosh tabedari karte rahe magar yeh un se bari aur bezar ho jayenge ya'ni azabon ko samne dekhte hue sab talluqat toot jayenge. Un se farmaya jayega ke duniya mein jinhein poojte rahe ho aaj unhein kyun nahin pukarte? Ab yeh pukarenge lekin koi jawab na payenge aur unhein yaqeen ho jayega ke yeh aag ke azab mein jayenge us waqt aarzoo karenge ke kaash hum rah-yafta hote? Jaise irshad hai ke ayat (Wa yauma yaqulu nadu shuraka'iyal lazina za'amtum fada'auhum falam yastajibu lahum wa ja'alna bainahum maubiqa) (18. Al-Kahf: 52) Jis din farmayega ke mere un shareekon ko awaz do jinhein tum bahut kuch samajh rahe thay yeh pukarenge lekin woh jawab na denge aur hum un ke aur un ke darmiyan aar kar denge mujrim log dozakh ko dekhenge phir bawar karayenge ke woh is mein girne wale hain lekin is se bachne ki koi rah na payenge. Isi qayamat wale din un sab ko suna kar ek sawal yeh bhi hoga ke tum ne mere ambiya ko kya jawab diya? Aur kahan tak un ka sath diya? Pehle tauheed ke mutaliq bazpurs thi ab risalat ke mutaliq sawal jawab ho rahe hain. Isi tarah qabr mein bhi sawal hota hai ke tera rab kaun hai? Tera nabi kaun hai? Aur tera deen kya hai? Momin jawab deta hai ke mera mabood sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur mere rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain jo Allah ke bande aur us ke rasool thay (Salam alaihi). Haan kafir se koi jawab nahin ban padta woh ghabrahat aur pareshani se kehta hai mujhe is ki koi khabar nahin. Andha behra ho jata hai jaise farmaya ayat (Wa man kana fi hazihil a'ma fahuwa fil akhirati a'ma wa adallu sabila) (17. Al-Isra: 72) Jo shakhs yahan andha hai woh wahan bhi andha aur rah bhoola rahega. Tamam daleelein un ki nigahon se hat jayengi rishte naate hasb-o-nasab ki koi qadr na hogi nasab namon ka koi sawal na hoga. Haan duniya mein tauba karne wale iman aur neki ke sath zindagi guzarne wale to beshak falah aur nijat hasil kar lenge yahan 'asa' yaqeen ke ma'ni mein hai ya'ni momin zaroor kamyab honge.

Hum to aaj tumhare sath kisi safarishi ko bhi nahin dekhte jinhein tum shareek-e-Ilahi thiraye hue thay. Tum mein un mein koi lagao nahin raha aur tumhare guman karda shareek sab aaj tum se khoye hue hain. Jin par azab ki baat sabit ho chuki yani shayateen aur sarkash log aur kufr ke bani aur shirk ki taraf logon ko bulane wale, yeh sab bade-bade log us din kahenge ke ae Allah hum ne inhein gumrah kiya aur unhon ne hamari kufriya baatein sunin aur manin, jaise hum behke hue thay unhein bhi behkaya. Hum un ki ibadat se tere samne apni bezari ka izhar karte hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Wattakhazu min dunillahi alihatan liyakunu lahum 'izza) (Surah Maryam: 81) unhon ne Allah ke siwa aur mabood bana liye taake woh un ke liye ba'is-e-izzat banein, lekin aisa nahin hone ka, yeh to unki ibadat se bhi inkar kar jayenge aur ulte un ke dushman ban jayenge. Aur ayat mein hai (Wa man adallu mimman yad'u min dunillahi mal la yastajeebu lahu ila yawmil qiyamati wahum 'an du'a'ihim ghafilun) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 5) us se barh kar gumrah kaun hai jo Allah ke siwa dusron ko pukarta hai jo Qayamat ki ghari tak unhein jawab na de sakein aur woh un ki pukar se bhi ghafil hon aur Qayamat ke din logon ke hashr ke mauqa par un ke dushman ban jayenge aur is baat se saaf inkar kar denge ke unhon ne unki ibadat ki thi. Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne apni qaum se farmaya tha ke tum ne jin buton ki pooja-paat shuru kar rakhi hai un se sirf duniya ki hi dosti hai, Qayamat ke din to tum sab ek dusre ke munkir ho jaoge aur ek dusre par la'nat bhejoge. Aur ayat mein hai (Iz tabarra'allazina tubbi'u minallazina taba'u wa ra'awul 'azaba wa taqatta'at bihimul asbab) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 166).

(Al-Baqarah: 166) Ya'ni jo tabedari karne wale thay aur woh unki purjosh tabedari karte rahe magar yeh un se bari aur bezar ho jayenge ya'ni azabon ko samne dekhte hue sab talluqat toot jayenge. Un se farmaya jayega ke duniya mein jinhein poojte rahe ho aaj unhein kyun nahin pukarte? Ab yeh pukarenge lekin koi jawab na payenge aur unhein yaqeen ho jayega ke yeh aag ke azab mein jayenge us waqt aarzoo karenge ke kaash hum rah-yafta hote? Jaise irshad hai ke ayat (Wa yauma yaqulu nadu shuraka'iyal lazina za'amtum fada'auhum falam yastajibu lahum wa ja'alna bainahum maubiqa) (18. Al-Kahf: 52) Jis din farmayega ke mere un shareekon ko awaz do jinhein tum bahut kuch samajh rahe thay yeh pukarenge lekin woh jawab na denge aur hum un ke aur un ke darmiyan aar kar denge mujrim log dozakh ko dekhenge phir bawar karayenge ke woh is mein girne wale hain lekin is se bachne ki koi rah na payenge. Isi qayamat wale din un sab ko suna kar ek sawal yeh bhi hoga ke tum ne mere ambiya ko kya jawab diya? Aur kahan tak un ka sath diya? Pehle tauheed ke mutaliq bazpurs thi ab risalat ke mutaliq sawal jawab ho rahe hain. Isi tarah qabr mein bhi sawal hota hai ke tera rab kaun hai? Tera nabi kaun hai? Aur tera deen kya hai? Momin jawab deta hai ke mera mabood sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur mere rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain jo Allah ke bande aur us ke rasool thay (Salam alaihi). Haan kafir se koi jawab nahin ban padta woh ghabrahat aur pareshani se kehta hai mujhe is ki koi khabar nahin. Andha behra ho jata hai jaise farmaya ayat (Wa man kana fi hazihil a'ma fahuwa fil akhirati a'ma wa adallu sabila) (17. Al-Isra: 72) Jo shakhs yahan andha hai woh wahan bhi andha aur rah bhoola rahega. Tamam daleelein un ki nigahon se hat jayengi rishte naate hasb-o-nasab ki koi qadr na hogi nasab namon ka koi sawal na hoga. Haan duniya mein tauba karne wale iman aur neki ke sath zindagi guzarne wale to beshak falah aur nijat hasil kar lenge yahan 'asa' yaqeen ke ma'ni mein hai ya'ni momin zaroor kamyab honge.

Sifat-e-Ilahi: Sari makhlooq ka Khaliq, tamam ikhtiyarat wala Allah hi hai. Na is mein koi is se jhagadne wala, na is ka shareek-o-saathi. Jo chahe paida kare, jise chahe apna khaas banda bana le. Jo chahta hai hota hai, jo nahin chahta ho nahin sakta. Tamam umoor, sab khair-o-sharr isi ke haath mein hai. Sab ki bazgasht isi ki janib hai, kisi ko koi ikhtiyar nahin. Yehi lafz isi ma'ani mein aayat (وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَّلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ اِذَا قَضَى اللّٰهُ وَرَسُوْلُهٗٓ اَمْرًا اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ لَهُمُ الْخِـيَرَةُ مِنْ اَمْرِهِمْ) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 36) mein hai, dono jagah 'ma' nafiya hai. Go Ibn-e-Jareer ne ye kaha ke 'ma' ma'ani mein 'allazi' ke hai, ya'ni Allah pasand karta hai use jis mein bhalai ho, aur is ma'ani ko le kar Mu'tazilion ne 'mura'at-e-saliheen' par istidlal kiya hai, lekin sahih baat yehi hai ke yahan 'ma' nafi ke ma'ani mein hai, jaise ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera se marwi hai. Ye aayat isi bayan mein hai ke makhlooq ki paidaish mein, taqdeer ke muqarrar karne mein, ikhtiyar rakhne mein Allah hi akela hai aur nazeer se paak hai. Isi liye aayat ke khatma par farmaya ke jab buton waghera ko woh shareek-e-Ilahi thehra rahe hain jo na kisi cheez ko bana saken, na kisi tarah ikhtiyar rakhen, Allah un sab se paak aur bahut door hai. Phir farmaya seenon aur dilon mein chupi hui baatein bhi Allah jaanta hai aur woh sab bhi us par isi tarah zahir hain jis tarah khullam khulla aur zahir baatein. Poshida baat kaho ya elan se kaho, woh sab ka Aalim hai. Raat mein aur din mein jo ho raha hai us par poshida nahin. Nekon ko jaza, badon ko saza woh us roz dega aur apni makhlooq mein faisle farmayega.

Go Ibn-e-Jareer ne ye kaha ke 'ma' ma'ani mein 'allazi' ke hai, ya'ni Allah pasand karta hai use jis mein bhalai ho, aur is ma'ani ko le kar Mu'tazilion ne 'mura'at-e-saliheen' par istidlal kiya hai, lekin sahih baat yehi hai ke yahan 'ma' nafi ke ma'ani mein hai, jaise ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera se marwi hai. Suni ansuni na karo, Allah Ta'ala ka ehsan dekho ke baghair tumhari koshish aur tadbeer ke din aur raat barabar aage peeche aa rahe hain. Agar raat hi raat rahe toh tum aajiz aa jao, tumhare kaam ruk jayen, tum par zindagi wabaal ho jaye, tum thak jao, ukta jao, kisi ko na pao jo tumhare liye din nikal sake ke tum uski roshni mein chalo phiro, dekho bhaalo, apne kaam kaaj kar lo. Afsos tum suna kar bhi besuna kar dete ho. Isi tarah agar woh tum par din hi din ko rok de, raat aaye hi nahin, toh bhi tumhari zindagi talkh ho jaye. Badan ka nizam ulat pulat ho jaye, thak jao, tang ho jao, koi nahin jise qudrat ho ke woh raat la sake jis mein tum rahat-o-aaram hasil kar sako, lekin tum aankhein rakhte hue Allah Ta'ala ki in nishaniyon aur meherbaniyon ko dekhte hi nahin ho. Yeh bhi us ka ehsan hai ke us ne din raat dono paida kar diye hain ke raat ko tumhein sukoon-o-aaram hasil ho aur din ko tum kaam kaaj, tijarat, zira'at, safar, shugal kar sako. Tumhein chahiye ke tum us Malik-e-Haqiqi, us Qadir-e-Mutlaq ka shukr ada karo. Raat ko us ki ibadatein karo, raat ke qusoor ki talafi din mein aur din ke qusoor ki talafi raat mein kar liya karo. Yeh mukhtalif cheezein qudrat ke namoone hain aur is liye hain ke tum nasihat-o-ibrat seekho aur Rabb ka shukr karo.

Iftira bandi chhor do. Mushrikon ko dusri dafa daant dikhayi jayegi aur farmaya jayega ke duniya mein jinhein mera shareek thahra rahe thay woh aaj kahan hain? Har ummat mein se ek gawah yani us ummat ka paighambar mumtaz kar liya jayega. Mushrikon se kaha jayega apne shirk ki koi daleel pesh karo. Us waqt yeh yaqeen kar lenge ke fi-alwaq ibadaton ke laiq Allah ke siwa aur koi nahin. Koi jawab na de sakenge, hairan reh jayenge aur tamam iftira bhool jayenge.

Qaroon: Marwi hai ke Qaroon Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke chacha ka larka tha. Is ka nasab yeh hai Qaroon bin Yis-har bin Qahis aur Musa (A.S) ka nasab yeh hai Musa bin Imran bin Qahis. Ibn-e-Ishaq ki tehqeeq yeh hai ke yeh Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka chacha tha. Lekin aksar ulama chacha ka larka batate hain. Yeh bohat khush-awaz tha, Taurat bari khush-ilhani se parhta tha is liye ise log munawwar kehte thay. Lekin jis tarah Samri ne munafiq-pana kiya tha yeh Allah ka dushman bhi munafiq ho gaya tha. Chunke bohat maal-dar tha is liye bhool gaya tha aur Allah ko bhool baitha tha. Qoum mein aam taur par jis libas ka dastoor tha us ne us se balisht bhar neecha libas banwaya tha jis se us ka ghuroor aur us ki daulat zahir ho. Is ke paas is qadar maal tha ke is khazanay ki kunjiyan uthane par qawi mardon ki aik jamaat muqarrar thi. Is ke bohat khazanay thay. Har khazanay ki kunji alag thi jo balisht bhar ki thi. Jab yeh kunjiyan is ki sawari ke sath khachron par ladi jatin to is ke liye sath (60) panch-kuliya khachar muqarrar hotay, Wallahu A'lam. Qoum ke buzurg aur nek logon aur aalimon ne jab is ki sarkashi aur takabbur ko had se barhte huay dekha to ise nasihat ki ke itna akar nahin, is qadar ghuroor na kar, Allah ka nashukra na ho, warna Allah ki mohabbat se door ho jao ge. Qoum ke waizon ne kaha ke yeh jo Allah ki na'matein tere paas hain inhein Allah ki razamandi ke kamon mein kharch kar taake aakhirat mein bhi tera hissa ho jaye. Yeh hum nahin kehte ke duniya mein kuch aish-o-ishrat kar hi nahin. Nahin, acha kha, pee, pehan orh, jaiz na'maton se faida utha, nikah se rahat utha, halal cheezein barat, lekin jahan apna khayal rakh wahan maskeenon ka bhi khayal rakh, jahan apne nafs ko na bhool wahan Allah ke haq bhi faramosh na kar. Tere nafs ka bhi haq hai, tere mehman ka bhi tujh par haq hai, tere baal-bachon ka bhi tujh par haq hai. Maskeen ghareeb ka bhi tere maal mein sajha hai. Har haq-dar ka haq ada kar aur jaise Allah ne tere sath sulook kiya tu auron ke sath sulook-o-ehsan kar, apne is mufsidana rawayye ko badal daal, Allah ki makhlooq ki eza-rasani se baaz aa ja. Allah fasadiyon se mohabbat nahin rakhta.

Apni aql-o-danish pe maghroor Qaroon, qoum ke ulama ki nasihaton ko sun kar Qaroon ne jo jawab diye us ka zikr ho raha hai ke us ne kaha aap apni nasihaton ko rehne dijiye, main khoob jaanta hoon ke Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe jo de rakha hai isi ka mustahiq main tha, main ek aqalmand, zeerak, daana shakhs hoon, main isi qabil hoon aur ise bhi Allah jaanta hai isi liye us ne mujhe yeh daulat di hai. Ba'az insanon ka yeh khasa hota hai jaise Quran mein hai ke jab insan ko koi takleef pahunchti hai tab badi aajizi se hamein pukarta hai aur jab insan ko koi ne'amat-o-rahat use hum de dete hain to keh deta hai ke aayat (QALA INNAMA OOTI TUHU ALA ILMIN INDEE, AWA LAM YA'LAM ANNALLAHA QAD AHLAKA MIN QABLIHI MINAL QUROONI MAN HUWA ASHADDU MINHU QUWWATAN WA AKTHARU JAM'AN, WA LA YUS'ALU AN ZUNOOBIHIMUL MUJRIMOON - 78) (Surah Al-Qasas: 78) yani Allah jaanta tha ke main isi ka mustahiq hoon is liye us ne mujhe yeh diya hai. Aur aayat mein hai ke agar hum use koi rahmat chakhayein us ke baad jab use museebat pahunchi ho to keh uthta hai ke haaza lee, is ka haqdar to main tha hi. Ba'az logon ne kaha hai ke Qaroon ilm-e-kimiya jaanta tha lekin yeh qaul bilkul za'eef hai. Balkeh kimiya ka ilm fi-al-waq'a hai hi nahin. Kyunke kisi cheez ke ain ko badal dena yeh Allah hi ki qudrat ki baat hai jis par koi aur qadir nahin. Farman-e-Ilahi hai ke agar tamam makhlooq bhi jama ho jaye to ek makkhi bhi paida nahin kar sakti. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke us se badh kar zalim kaun hai jo koshish karta hai ke meri tarah paidaish kare. Agar woh saccha hai to ek zarra ya ek jau hi bana de. Yeh hadith un ke baare mein hai jo tasveerein utarte hain aur sirf zahir surat ko naqal karte hain. Un ke liye to yeh farmaya phir jo da'wa kare ke woh kimiya jaanta hai aur ek cheez ki kaya palat kar sakta hai, ek zaat se dusri zaat bana deta hai maslan lohay ko sona waghera to saaf zahir hai ke yeh mehez jhoot hai aur bilkul muhaal hai aur jahalat-o-zalalat hai. Haan yeh aur baat hai ke rang waghera badal kar dhokay baazi kare. Lekin haqeeqatan yeh namumkin hai. Yeh kimiya gar jo mehez jhootay, jahil, fasiq aur muftari hain, yeh mehez da'way kar ke makhlooq ko dhokay mein daalne wale hain. Haan yeh khayal rahe ke ba'az auliya ke hathon jo karamatein sarzad ho jaati hain aur kabhi kabhi cheezein badal jaati hain un ka hamein inkar nahin. Woh Allah ki taraf se un par ek khaas fazl hota hai aur woh bhi un ke bas ka nahin hota, na un ke qabzay ka hota hai, na koi kaari gari, san'at ya ilm hai. Woh mehez Allah ke farman ka natija hai jo Allah apne farmanbardar nek kaar bandon ke hathon apni makhlooq ko dikha deta hai. Chunancha marwi hai ke Hazrat Haywah bin Shuraih Misri R.H se ek martaba kisi saail ne sawal kiya aur aap ke paas kuch na tha aur us ki haajat mandi aur zaroorat ko dekh kar aap dil mein bohat aazurda ho rahe thay.

Aakhir aap ne ek kankar zameen se uthaya aur kuch der apne hathon mein ulat-palat karke faqeer ki jholi mein daal diya toh woh sone ka ban gaya. Mojzon aur karamat ahadees aur aasar mein aur bhi bahut se marwi hain. Jinhein yahan bayan karna ba'is-e-tool hoga. Ba'az ka qaul hai ke Qaroon Ism-e-Azam jaanta tha jise parh kar usne apni maaldari ki dua ki toh is qadar daulat-mand ho gaya. Qaroon ke is jawab ki radd mein Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke yeh ghalat hai ke main jis par meharban hota hoon use daulat-mand kardeta hoon, nahin, is se pehle is se zyada daulat aur aasuda-haal logon ko main ne tabah kardiya hai, toh yeh samajh lena ke maaldari meri mohabbat ki nishani hai, mehez ghalat hai. Jo mera shukr ada na karein, kufr par jama rahe, uska anjam-e-bad hota hai. Gunahgaron ke kasrat-e-gunah ki wajah se phir un se un ke gunahon ka sawal bhi abas hota. Uska khayal tha ke mujh mein khairiyat hai is liye Allah ka yeh fazl mujh par hua hai. Woh jaanta hai ke main is maaldari ka ahl hoon, agar mujh se khush na hota aur mujhe achha aadmi na jaanta toh mujhe apni yeh ne'amat bhi na deta.

Samaan-e-Taya'yush ki farawani: Qaroon ek din nihayat qeemti poshak pehan kar zarq-barq umda sawari par sawar ho kar apne ghulamon ko aage peeche besh-baha poshakein pehnaye hue le kar bade thaath se itrata hua akadta hua nikla. Uska yeh thaath aur yeh zeenat-o-tajammul dekh kar duniya-daron ke munh mein paani bhar aaya aur kehne lage kaash ke hamare paas bhi is jitna maal hota. Yeh toh bada khush-naseeb hai aur badi qismat wala hai. Ulama-e-Kiram ne unki yeh baat sun kar unhein is khayal se rokna chaha aur unhein samjhane lage ke dekho Allah Ta'ala ne jo kuch apne momin aur nek bandon ke liye apne haan tayyar kar rakha hai woh is se karorha darja ba-ronaq, der-pa aur umda hai. Tumhein un darjaat ko hasil karne ke liye is do-roza zindagi ko sabr-o-bardasht se guzarna chahiye, jannat sabiron ka hissa hai. Yeh matlab bhi hai ke aise paak kalme sabr karne walon ki zaban hi se nikalte hain jo duniya ki mohabbat se door aur daar-e-akhirat ki mohabbat mein choor hote hain. Is surat mein mumkin hai ke yeh kalam un wa'izon ka na ho balkeh unke kaam ki aur unki tareef mein yeh jumla Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se khabar ho.

Samaan-e-Taya'yush ki farawani: Qaroon ek din nihayat qeemti poshak pehan kar zarq-barq umda sawari par sawar ho kar apne ghulamon ko aage peeche besh-baha poshakein pehnaye hue le kar bade thaath se itrata hua akadta hua nikla. Ek baalisht ka aadmi? Upar Qaroon ki sarkashi-o-be-imani ka zikr ho chuka, yahan us ke anjam ka bayan ho raha hai. Ek hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek shakhs apna tehband latkaye fakhr se ja raha tha ke Allah ne zameen ko hukum diya ke ise nigal ja. Kitab-ul-Ajaib mein Naufal bin Mahiq kehte hain ke Najran ki masjid mein main ne ek naujawan ko dekha, bada lamba choda, bharpoor jawani ke nasha mein choor, gathay huay badan wala, banka-tircha, achay rang-o-roghan wala, khoobsurat, shakeel. Main nigahain jama kar us ke jamal-o-kamal ko dekhne laga to us ne kaha kya dekh rahe ho? Main ne kaha aap ke husn-o-jamal ka mushahida kar raha hoon aur ta'ajjub maloom ho raha hai. Us ne jawab diya ke tu hi kya khud Allah Ta'ala ko bhi ta'ajjub hai. Naufal kehte hain ke is kalma ke kehte hi woh ghutnay laga aur us ka rang-roop udne laga aur qad past hone laga yahan tak ke be-qadar ek baalisht ka reh gaya. Aakhir-kaar us ka koi qareebi rishtedar apni aastin mein daal kar le gaya. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke Qaroon ki halakat Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki bad-dua se hui thi aur is ke sabab mein bohat kuch ikhtilaf hai. Ek sabab to yeh bayan kiya jata hai ke Qaroon maloon ne ek fahisha aurat ko bohat kuch maal-o-mata de kar is baat par aamada kiya ke ain us waqt jab Hazrat Musa Kaleemullah Bani Israel mein kharay khutba keh rahe hon woh aaye aur aap se kahe ke tu wahi hai na jis ne mere sath aisa aisa kiya. Us aurat ne yahi kiya, Hazrat Musa (A.S) kaanp uthay aur usi waqt namaz ki niyat baandh li aur do rakat ada kar ke us aurat ki taraf mutawajja huay aur farmanay lagay tujhe us Allah ki qasam jis ne samundar mein se rasta diya aur teri qoum ko Firaun ke mazalim se nijat di aur bhi bohat se ehsanat kiye, to jo saccha waqia hai use bayan kar. Yeh sun kar us aurat ka rang badal gaya aur us ne sahih waqia sab ke samne bayan kar diya aur Allah se istighfar kiya aur sacchay dil se tauba kar li. Hazrat Musa (A.S) phir sajda mein gir gaye aur Qaroon ki saza chahi. Allah ki taraf se wahi nazil hui ke main ne zameen ko tere tabe kar diya hai. Aap ne sajday se sar uthaya aur zameen se kaha ke tu ise aur is ke mahal ko nigal le. Zameen ne yahi kiya. Doosra sabab yeh bayan kiya jata hai ke jab Qaroon ki sawari is tamtaraq se nikli, safed qeemti khachar par besh-baha poshak pehney sawar tha, us ke ghulam bhi sab ke sab reshmi libason mein thay. Idhar Hazrat Musa (A.S) khutba parh rahe thay, Bani Israel ka majma tha. Yeh jab wahan se nikla to sab ki nigahain us par aur us ki dhoom-dhaam par lag gayin. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ise dekh kar poocha aaj is tarah kaise niklay? Us ne kaha baat yeh hai ke ek baat Allah ne tumhein de rakhi hai aur ek fazilat mujhe de rakhi hai, agar tumhare paas nabuwat hai to mere paas yeh jah-o-hasham hai aur agar aap ko meri fazilat par shak ho to main tayyar hoon ke aap aur main chalein aur Allah se dua karein. Dekh lijiye ke Allah kis ki dua qabool farmata hai. Aap is baat par aamada ho gaye aur us ko le kar chalay.

Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya ke pehle tu dua karta hai ya main karoon? Usne kaha nahin main karunga. Ab usne dua mangni shuru kardi aur khatam hogayi lekin dua qabool na hui. Hazrat Musa A.S ne kaha ab dua main karta hoon, usne kaha haan kijiye. Aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke ya Allah zameen ko hukum de ke jo main kahoon maan le. Allah ne aap ki dua qabool farmayi aur wahi aayi ke main ne zameen ko teri ita'at ka hukum de diya hai. Hazrat Musa A.S ne yeh sun kar zameen se farmaya ae zameen! Ise aur is ke logon ko pakad le. Wahin yeh log apne qadam tak zameen mein dhans gaye. Aap ne farmaya aur pakad le. Yeh apne ghutno tak dhans gaye. Aap ne farmaya aur pakad, yeh mundho tak zameen mein dhans gaye. Phir farmaya in ke khazane aur maal bhi yahin le aa. Isi waqt in ke kul khazane aur maal wahan aa gaye aur unhon ne apni aankhon se un sab ko dekh liya. Phir aap ne apne hath se ishara kiya ke in ko in ke khazano samet apne andar kar le, isi waqt yeh sab gharat hogaye aur zameen jaisi thi waisi hogayi. Marwi hai ke saato zameen tak yeh log ba-qadr-e-insaan dhans-te ja rahe hain, Qayamat tak isi azaab mein rahenge. Yahan par Bani Israel ki aur bohat si riwayatein hain lekin hum ne un ka zikr yahan chhod diya hai. Na to maal un ke kaam aaya na jaah-o-hasham, na daulat-o-tamakunt, na koi un ki madad ke liye utha, na yeh khud apna koi bachao kar sake. Tabah hogaye, be-nishan hogaye, mit gaye aur mita diye gaye (A'azana Allah). Is waqt to un logon ki bhi aankhein khul gayi jo Qaroon ki daulat ko lalchayi hui nazron se dekhte the aur use naseeb-daar samajh kar lambe saans liya karte the aur rashk kiya karte the ke kaash hum aise daulat-mand hote. Woh kehne lage ab dekh liya ke waqayi sach hai daulat-mand hona kuch Allah ki razamandi ka sabab nahin. Yeh Allah ki hikmat hai jise chahe zyada de, jise chahe kam de. Jis par chahe wus'at kare, jis par chahe tang kare. Is ki hikmatein wahi jaanta hai. Ek hadith mein bhi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne tum mein akhlaq ki bhi isi tarah taqseem ki hai jis tarah rozi ki. Maal to Allah ki taraf se is ke doston ko bhi milta hai aur is ke dushmano ko bhi. Albatta imaan Allah ki taraf se usi ko milta hai jise Allah chahta ho. Qaroon ke is dhansaye jaane ko dekh kar woh jo is jaisa banne ki ummeedein kar rahe the kehne lage agar Allah ka lutf-o-ehsaan hum par na hota to hamari is tamanna ke badle jo hamare dil mein thi ke kaash hum bhi aise hi hote, aaj Allah Ta'ala hamein bhi is ke sath dhansa deta. Woh kaafir tha aur kaafir Allah ke haan falah ke laiq nahin hote. Na unhein duniya mein kamyabi mile na Aakhirat mein hi woh chhutkara payein. Nahwi kehte hain 'Waik'an' ke ma'ani 'Wailaka i'lam anna' hain lekin mukhaffaf karke 'Waik' reh gaya aur 'Anna' ke fatha ne 'I'lam' ke mehzoof hone par dalalat kardi. Lekin is qaul ko Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H ne za'eef bataya hai. Magar main kehta hoon yeh za'eef kehna theek nahin.

Quran-e-Kareem mein is ki kitabat ka ek saath hona is ke za'eef hone ki wajah nahin ban sakta. Is liye ke kitabat ka tareeqa toh ikhtira'i amr hai jo riwaj pa gaya wohi mo'tabar samjha jata hai. Is se ma'ni par koi asar nahin hota. Wallahu A'lam. Dusre ma'ni is ke 'Alam Tara' in ke liye gaye hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is tarah yeh do lafz hain 'Wai' aur 'Ka'. Harf-e-Wai ta'ajjub ke liye hain aur 'Ya' tanbeeh ke liye aur 'Ka' ma'ni mein 'Azzun' ke hai. In tamam aqwal mein qawi qaul yeh hai ke yeh ma'ni mein 'Alam Tara' ke hai yani kya na dekha tu ne jaise ke Hazrat Qatada (R.H) ka qaul hai aur yahi ma'ni Arabi sher mein bhi murad liye gaye hain.

Jannat aur Aakhirat. Farmata hai ke Jannat aur Aakhirat ki ne'amat sirf unhi ko milegi jin ke dilon mein khauf-e-Ilahi bhara hua ho aur duniya ki zindagi tawazo, farotani, aajizi aur akhlaq ke sath guzar dein. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se manqool hai ke jise yeh baat achi lage ke us ki jooti ka tasma apne sathi ki jooti ke tasmay se acha ho to woh bhi isi aayat mein dakhil hai. Yeh to khoobsurti hai, Allah Ta'ala Jameel hai aur jamal ko pasand karta hai. Phir farmaya jo hamare paas neki layega woh bahut si nekiyon ka sawab payega. Yeh maqam-e-fazl hai aur burai ka badla sirf usi ke mutabiq saza hai. Jo burai le kar aayega woh andhay munh aag mein jayega. Tumhein wahi badla diya jayega jo tum karte rahe.

Jo karoge so bharoge. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko hukm farmata hai ke risalat ki tabligh karte rahein, logon ko Kalam-e-Allah sunate rahein. Allah Ta'ala aap ko Qayamat ki taraf wapas le jane wala hai aur wahan nabuwwat ki babat pursish hogi. Jaise farman hai: Ayat (Falanas'alannallazina ursilu ilaihim wa lanas'alannal mursalin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 6), yani ummaton se aur rasoolon se sab se hum daryaft farmayenge. Aur ayat mein hai rasoolon ko jama karke Allah Ta'ala puchega ke tumhein kya jawab diya gaya? Aur ayat mein hai nabiyon ko aur gawahon ko laya jayega. Ma'ad se murad Jannat bhi ho sakti hai, maut bhi ho sakti hai, dobara ki zindagi bhi ho sakti hai ke dobara paida hon aur dakhil-e-Jannat hon. Sahih Bukhari mein hai is se murad Makkah hai. Mujahid se marwi hai ke is se murad Makkah hai jo aap ki jaye paidaish thi. Zahhak farmate hain jab Huzoor (ﷺ) Makkah se nikle, abhi Juhfa hi mein the ke aap ke dil mein Makkah ka shauq paida hua, pas yeh ayat utri aur aap se wada hua ke aap wapas Makkah pahunchaye jayenge. Is se yeh bhi nikalta hai ke yeh ayat Madani ho halankeh puri surat Makki hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad is se Bait-ul-Muqaddas hai, shayad is kehne wale ki gharz is se bhi Qayamat hai, is liye ke Bait-ul-Muqaddas hi mahshar-e-zameen hai. In tamam aqwal mein jama ki surat yeh hai ke Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne kabhi to aap ke Makkah ki taraf lautne se is ki tafsir ki hai jo Fatah-e-Makkah se puri hui. Aur yeh Huzoor (ﷺ) ki umr ke pura hone ki ek zabardast alamat thi jaise ke aap ne Surah Iza Ja'a ki tafsir mein farmaya hai, jis ki Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne bhi muwafiqat ki thi aur farmaya tha ke jo tu janta hai wahi main bhi janta hoon. Yahi wajah hai ke unhi se is ayat ki tafsir mein jahan Makkah marwi hai wahan Huzoor (ﷺ) ka inteqal bhi marwi hai aur kabhi Qayamat se tafsir ki kyunke maut ke baad Qayamat hai aur kabhi Jannat se tafsir ki jo aap ka thikana hai aur aap ki tabligh-e-risalat ka badal hai ke aap ne jinn-o-ins ko Allah ke deen ki dawat di aur aap tamam makhlooq se zyada kalam, zyada faseeh aur zyada afzal the. Phir farmaya ke apne mukhalifeen se aur jhutlane walon se keh do ke hum mein se hidayat walon ko aur gumrahi walon ko Allah khoob janta hai. Tum dekh loge ke kis ka anjam behtar hota hai? Aur duniya aur aakhirat mein behtari aur bhalai kis ke hisse mein aati hai? Phir apni ek aur zabardast ne'amat bayan farmata hai ke wahi utarne se pehle kabhi aap ko yeh khayal bhi na guzra tha ke aap par Kitab nazil hogi. Yeh to tujh par aur tamam makhlooq par Rabb ki rahmat hui ke us ne tujh par apni pak aur afzal Kitab nazil farmayi. Ab tumhein hargiz kafiron ka madadgar na hona chahiye balkeh un se alag rehna chahiye. Un se bezari zahir kar deni chahiye aur un se mukhalifat ka elan kar dena chahiye. Phir farmaya ke Allah ki utri hui ayaton se yeh log kahin tujhe rok na dein, yani jo tere deen ki mukhalifat karte hain aur logon ko teri tabedari se rokte hain.

Toh is se asar-pazeer na hona apne kaam par lage rehna Allah tere kalme ko buland karne wala hai tere deen ki ta'eed karne wala hai teri risalat ko ghalib karne wala hai. Tamam deenon par tere deen ko ooncha karne wala hai. Toh apne Rab ki ibadat ki taraf logon ko bulata reh jo akela aur la-shareek hai tujhe nahin chahiye ke mushrikon ka sath de. Allah ke sath kisi aur ko na pukar. Ibadat ke laiq wahi hai uloohiyat ke qabil usi ki azeem-ush-shan zaat hai wahi da'im aur baqi hai Hayy-o-Qayyum hai tamam makhlooq mar jayegi aur woh maut se door hai. Tere Rab ka chehra hi baqi reh jayega jo jalalat-o-karamat wala hai. Wajh se murad zaat hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sab se zyada sacha kalma Labeed shayar ka hai jo us ne kaha hai sher: (Ala kullu shai'in ma khala Allahu batil) Yaad rakho ke Allah ke siwa sab kuch batil hai. Mujahid-o-Saur se marwi hai ke har cheez batil hai magar woh kaam jo Allah ki raza-joi ke liye kiye jayen un ka sawab reh jata hai. Shayaron ke sheron mein bhi wajh ka lafz is matlab ke liye istemal kiya gaya hai mulahiza ho. Sher: (Astaghfirullaha zamban lastu muhsiyahu, Rabbul 'ibadi ilaihil wajhu wal-'amalu) Main Allah se jo tamam bandon ka Rab hai jis ki taraf tawajjah aur qasd hai aur jis ke liye amal hain apne un tamam gunahon ki bakhshish chahta hoon jinhein main shumar bhi nahin kar sakta. Yeh qaul pehle qaul ke khilaf nahin. Yeh bhi apni jagah sahih hai ke insan ke tamam a'maal akarat hain sirf un hi nekiyon ke badle ka mustahiq hai jo mehez Allah Ta'ala ki raza-joi ke liye ki hoon. Aur pehle qaul ka matlab bhi bilkul sahih hai ke sab jandar fani aur zail hain sirf Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki zaat pak hai jo fana aur zawal se balatar hai. Wahi Awwal-o-Aakhir hai har cheez se pehle tha aur har cheez ke baad rahega. Marwi hai ke jab Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) apne dil ko mazboot karna chahte the toh jungle mein kisi khandhar ke darwaze par khade ho jate aur dardnak awaz se kehte ke is ke bani kahan hain? Phir khud jawab mein yahi padhte. Hukm-o-mulk aur malkiyat sirf usi ki hai malik-o-mutasarrif wahi hai. Us ke hukm-o-ahkaam ko koi rad nahin kar sakta. Roz-e-Jaza sab usi ki taraf lautaye jayenge. Woh sab ko un nekiyon aur badiyon ka badla dega. Nek ko nek badla aur bure ko buri saza. Alhamdulillah Surah Qasas ki tafsir khatam hui.

Sher: (Astaghfirullaha zamban lastu muhsiyahu, Rabbul 'ibadi ilaihil wajhu wal-'amalu) Main Allah se jo tamam bandon ka Rab hai jis ki taraf tawajjah aur qasd hai aur jis ke liye amal hain apne un tamam gunahon ki bakhshish chahta hoon jinhein main shumar bhi nahin kar sakta. Yeh qaul pehle qaul ke khilaf nahin. Yeh bhi apni jagah sahih hai ke insan ke tamam a'maal akarat hain sirf un hi nekiyon ke badle ka mustahiq hai jo mehez Allah Ta'ala ki raza-joi ke liye ki hoon. Aur pehle qaul ka matlab bhi bilkul sahih hai ke sab jandar fani aur zail hain sirf Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki zaat pak hai jo fana aur zawal se balatar hai. Wahi Awwal-o-Aakhir hai har cheez se pehle tha aur har cheez ke baad rahega. Marwi hai ke jab Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) apne dil ko mazboot karna chahte the toh jungle mein kisi khandhar ke darwaze par khade ho jate aur dardnak awaz se kehte ke is ke bani kahan hain? Phir khud jawab mein yahi padhte. Hukm-o-mulk aur malkiyat sirf usi ki hai malik-o-mutasarrif wahi hai. Us ke hukm-o-ahkaam ko koi rad nahin kar sakta. Roz-e-Jaza sab usi ki taraf lautaye jayenge. Woh sab ko un nekiyon aur badiyon ka badla dega. Nek ko nek badla aur bure ko buri saza. Alhamdulillah Surah Qasas ki tafsir khatam hui.
